abstract: Despite their considerable promise, many current medical foundation models remain modality specific and lack transparent reasoning, limiting clinical adoption. To address this gap, we introduce Explainable Vision Language Foundation Model for Medicine (EVLF-FM), a multimodal vision language foundation model that combines broad diagnostic capabilities with fine-grained explainability. The development and testing of EVLF-FM encompassed more than 1.3 million total samples from 18 global datasets across 10 imaging modalities related to six clinical specialties: dermatology, hepatology, ophthalmology, pathology, pulmonology and radiology. External validation employed 13,443 independent test samples from 17 additional datasets across 10 imaging modalities. EVLF-FM supports disease diagnosis, visual question answering and pixel-level visual grounding with reasoning capabilities. In internal validation for disease diagnostics, EVLF-FM achieved the highest average accuracy, 0.895, outperforming leading generalist and specialist models. In medical visual grounding, EVLF-FM also achieved reasonable performance across nine modalities with average accuracy at 0.5 intersection over union (Acc@0.5) of 0.842. External testing further confirmed consistent zero-shot and few-shot performance, with competitive F1 scores despite a smaller model size. A hybrid training strategy combining supervised and visual reinforcement fine-tuning enables EVLF-FM to generate clinically interpretable explanations aligned with visual evidence. Human evaluation of these reasoning outputs using the S.C.O.R.E. framework yielded a high overall mean score of 4.25/5, supporting their clinical interpretability. Current limitations include the need for additional validation across diverse healthcare settings. Prospective clinical studies are required to evaluate the safety, effectiveness and clinical utility of EVLF-FM before routine clinical deployment. A multimodal vision language foundation model, EVLF-FM, integrates extensive clinical data and advanced training techniques, achieving superior diagnostic accuracy and explainability across diverse imaging modalities, enhancing clinical decision-making through robust reasoning and interpretability.

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To compare patient trust in educational health contentand the physician providing it, when authorship is attributed to a physician or generative artificial intelligence (AI). In a preregistered randomized, parallel survey study, participants read a health education article. Individuals were randomized to 1 of 4 conditions, attributing authorship of an identical article to (1) a physician author, (2) generative AI, (3) a physician assisted by AI (hybrid authorship), or (4) no author. Pregnant or postpartum English-speaking US adults (n = 400) were recruited in August-October 2025 via an online survey panel. Eighty percent passed timing and attention checks. Participants rated article engagement, content trust, and trust in the (hypothetical) recommending physician with Likert-scales. Bonferroni corrections were applied to post hoc pairwise comparisons (α = 0.05). Among participants who correctly recalled authorship (n = 195), AI-only authorship was associated with lower trust in content (mean, 9.43 vs 11.11; P = .001) and the recommending physician (mean, 8.93 vs 10.84; P = .03) compared with physician-only authorship, while hybrid authorship did not differ significantly from physician-only authorship for either outcome (content: P = .08; physician: P > .99). Sensitivity analyses including all participants (n = 321) were generally consistent with the primary findings. Engagement did not differ significantly across conditions in the primary analytic sample. As generative AI becomes increasingly integrated into clinical care, how AI involvement and physician oversight are communicated to patients could have important implications for patient trust. AI authorship was associated with reduced trust in patient-facing education despite identical, clinician-written content.

abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] Radiology reports serve as the definitive clinical record of imaging diagnoses, with their accuracy being directly critical to patient safety. However, amid escalating workloads, manual review remains inadequate for capturing subtle errors in reports on a large scale. Although large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable promise in medical text processing, previous studies have predominantly been confined to radiology report text from a single imaging modality or datasets with synthetic errors. This study aimed to evaluate the feasibility, accuracy, and generalizability of general-purpose LLMs for quality assurance of radiology report text from multiple imaging modalities (x-ray, computed tomography [CT], and magnetic resonance imaging [MRI]), multi-anatomical regions, and multicenter clinical settings, with head-to-head comparisons conducted against radiologists of varying seniority. zh_abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] 放射学报告是影像诊断的最终临床记录，其准确性直接关系到患者安全。然而，在工作量不断攀升的情况下，人工审核仍不足以在大规模范围内捕获报告中的细微错误。尽管大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）在医学文本处理中已展现出相当大的前景，但既往研究主要局限于单一成像模态的放射学报告文本或带有合成错误的数据集。本研究旨在评估通用 LLMs 对来自多种成像模态（X 线、计算机断层扫描[computed tomography, CT]和磁共振成像[magnetic resonance imaging, MRI]）、多解剖区域和多中心临床环境的放射学报告文本进行质量保证的可行性、准确性和泛化性，并与不同资历的放射科医生进行头对头比较。从中心 1（2025 年 3 月至 2025 年 5 月）回顾性收集上述 3 种成像模态和 5 个解剖区域（头部、胸部、腹部、脊柱和膝部）的放射学报告文本，并使用由临床医生标注的 5 类错误分类法（类型 1：解释性；类型 2：事实性）进行审核。在 10,000 份随机选择的报告上对五种 LLMs（Qwen3、GPT-5.4 Pro、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Llama 4 和 DeepSeek-V3.1）进行基准测试，并在完整队列上评估表现最佳的模型。与 3 名放射科医生（3-10 年经验）进行的盲法头对头比较使用了按成像模态分层、错误富集的挑战集。随后，放射科医生使用 5 点李克特量表对模型生成的解释进行评分。在独立外部队列中评估跨中心性能。同样的 2 名资深放射科医生使用相同方案对来自两个中心的报告进行标注，并通过共识解决分歧。总体而言，中心 1 中 4.6%（4431/95,582）的报告至少包含一个已确认的文本内部错误。被选中的模型 Qwen3 在报告层面达到的灵敏度、特异度、阳性预测值和 F1 分数分别为 0.99、0.99、0.90 和 0.94，在来自 3 种成像模态和多个解剖区域的报告上均表现良好，且对事实性错误的检测优于对解释性错误的检测。在错误富集的挑战集中，其对错误实例精确类别的召回率超过放射科医生（0.96 vs 0.45-0.67；P<.001），且平均任务完成时间更短（每份报告 5.80 秒 vs 55.80-67.80 秒）。

abstract: [The Journal of clinical endocrinology and metabolism] Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for clinical decision support (CDS), but evaluation under clinical equipoise-scenarios lacking a consensus correct answer-remains rare. We evaluated commercially available LLM performance for thyroid nodule biopsy recommendations under clinical equipoise. One hundred clinical vignettes describing patients with incidentally discovered thyroid nodules of varying sizes and risk features were presented to 94 clinicians, recruited by convenience sampling from professional networks, and multiple LLMs (GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 3.5/4.0/4.5, Llama 3.2-90B, Deepseek R1, and OpenEvidence). Responses were dichotomized as biopsy versus no biopsy. Agreement was assessed using Krippendorff's alpha, and a deterministic algorithm served as a provisional benchmark. Selected LLM responses were reviewed by experts. Clinicians recommended biopsy in 58% of responses (95% CI 50%, 66%), with unanimous responses in only 50 vignettes. LLM biopsy rates ranged from 46% (Claude 3.5) to 74% (Llama 3.2-90B). LLM-clinician agreement was moderate (α = 0.372-0.453). Agreement with the deterministic algorithm ranged from high (α = 0.954, Detailed TIRADS GPT-5) to low (α = 0.265, Claude Sonnet 4.5). Llama 3.2-90B recommended biopsy in 8 of 8 cases where clinicians unanimously recommended against it. LLMs differed meaningfully in biopsy recommendation patterns, with potential population-level consequences. Evaluating and aligning LLMs for CDS under equipoise requires stakeholders and processes analogous to clinical guideline committees. Because LLMs used as CDS could powerfully disseminate different practice patterns, this creates new responsibilities for guidelines committees and other stakeholders.

abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Small unruptured intracranial aneurysms (UIAs; ≤ 7 mm) carry collectively significant rupture risk, yet conventional scoring tools (PHASES, ELAPSS) perform near chance-level in this subgroup. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the pooled diagnostic accuracy of AI-based models for rupture risk prediction in small UIAs and compared performance across algorithmic architectures. Prospectively registered with PROSPERO (CRD420251142915) and conducted per PRISMA-DTA/PRISMA-S standards. MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science were searched in October 2025 and updated on June 2026. Eligible studies applied machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), radiomics, or computational fluid dynamics-integrated models to small UIAs. Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) was pooled via a three-level random-effects model with restricted maximum likelihood estimation and Knapp-Hartung correction; heterogeneity was explored through multivariable meta-regression. Bias and reporting quality were assessed using QUADAS-3 and METRICS, respectively. Ten studies (2019-2025) encompassing 5409 patients, 7057 aneurysms, and 62 models were included. Pooled AUC was 0.793 (95% CI 0.754-0.827), with sensitivity of 0.713 and specificity of 0.780. Conventional ML achieved the highest AUC (0.827), followed by statistical models (0.779) and DL (0.741). Meta-regression explained 76.2% of variance; statistical model family was the sole significant predictor of inferior performance (p = 0.002). Nine of ten studies carried high risk of bias. No publication bias was detected (p = 0.186). AI-based models, particularly conventional ML ensemble architectures, demonstrate moderate-to-good discriminative accuracy for small UIA rupture risk stratification, meaningfully surpassing conventional scoring tools. Multicenter prospective registries, pre-rupture imaging protocols, and explainable AI frameworks are essential to support transparent neurosurgical decision-making.
zh_abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] 小型未破裂颅内动脉瘤（UIAs；≤ 7 mm）总体上具有显著的破裂风险，但传统评分工具（PHASES、ELAPSS）在该亚组中的表现接近随机水平。本系统综述与荟萃分析评估了基于人工智能（AI）的模型预测小型UIAs破裂风险的合并诊断准确性，并比较了不同算法架构之间的性能。该研究前瞻性注册于PROSPERO（CRD420251142915），并按照PRISMA-DTA/PRISMA-S标准开展。于2025年10月检索MEDLINE、Scopus和Web of Science，并于2026年6月更新。符合条件的研究将机器学习（ML）、深度学习（DL）、影像组学或整合计算流体动力学的模型应用于小型UIAs。采用三水平随机效应模型、限制性最大似然估计和Knapp-Hartung校正对受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）进行合并；通过多变量荟萃回归探讨异质性。分别使用QUADAS-3和METRICS评估偏倚风险和报告质量。共纳入10项研究（2019—2025年），涵盖5409例患者、7057个动脉瘤和62个模型。合并AUC为0.793（95% CI 0.754—0.827），灵敏度为0.713，特异度为0.780。传统ML获得最高AUC（0.827），其次为统计模型（0.779）和DL（0.741）。荟萃回归解释了76.2%的方差；统计模型类别是性能较差的唯一显著预测因素（p = 0.002）。10项研究中有9项存在高偏倚风险。未检测到发表偏倚（p = 0.186）。基于AI的模型，尤其是传统ML集成架构，对小型UIA破裂风险分层表现出中等至良好的判别准确性，显著优于传统评分工具。多中心前瞻性登记、破裂前影像学方案以及可解释AI框架对于支持透明的神经外科决策至关重要。

title: AI-guided discovery and expansion of the human bile acid landscape.

abstract: [Cell metabolism] Bile acids represent one of nature's most chemically diverse and therapeutically important metabolite families. However, the human bile acid metabolome remains largely uncharted, with analytical limitations obscuring potentially thousands of biologically active species present in cells and biofluids. Here, we present MetLLM, a transformer-based language model that learns bile acid modification patterns to prioritize candidate bile acid analogs, and MetSpace, an in silico bile acid chemical landscape containing 3,900 prioritized candidates. Liquid chromatography-high resolution mass spectrometry analysis of human feces confirmed multiple newly detected and structurally novel bile acids, including MS2141 and MS1281. In vitro functional validation showed that MS2141 modulates M2 receptor-associated Gi/o signaling and alters electrophysiological parameters in human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes. This work expands the searchable bile acid metabolome and provides a computational framework for systematic metabolite discovery.
zh_abstract: 【细胞代谢】胆汁酸代表了自然界中化学多样性最丰富且具有治疗重要性的代谢物家族之一。然而，人类胆汁酸代谢组在很大程度上仍未被描绘，分析局限性掩盖了细胞和生物体液中可能存在的数千种生物活性物种。在此，我们提出MetLLM，这是一种基于Transformer的语言模型，学习胆汁酸修饰模式以对候选胆汁酸类似物进行优先级排序；还提出MetSpace，这是一个计算机模拟的胆汁酸化学景观，包含3,900个优先候选物。对人粪便进行液相色谱-高分辨质谱分析，证实了多种新检测到且结构新颖的胆汁酸，包括MS2141和MS1281。体外功能验证表明，MS2141调节M2受体相关的Gi/o信号传导，并改变人诱导多能干细胞来源心肌细胞的电生理参数。本工作扩展了可搜索的胆汁酸代谢组，并为系统性代谢物发现提供了计算框架。

title: Agentic Discovery Transfer Enables Cross-Cancer Discovery at Scale
zh_title: SMART多智能体框架实现跨癌种发现迁移
summary: 预印本提出多智能体LLM框架SMART，在121项单细胞研究中检验发现能否跨癌种迁移并给出后续分析建议。
key_points: 定义「发现迁移」任务并构建多智能体LLM框架
覆盖六种癌症、121项scRNA-seq研究

abstract: Cancer research generates tens of thousands of studies each year, yet whether a published finding holds in another cancer type or patient population is rarely tested, because doing so is labor-intensive and difficult to scale. We define this task as discovery transfer and present SMART, a multi-agent large language model framework for discovery transfer in single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) studies. Given a source manuscript and a target scRNA-seq dataset, SMART extracts major clinical and mechanistic findings, generates and executes analyses for the testable findings, and reports which findings transfer and suggests follow-up. Applied to 121 studies across six cancer types, SMART identified findings that transfer across cancers, including a lung cancer prognostic signature that we confirmed to be associated with survival in liver cancer, pancreatic cancer and pleural mesothelioma. SMART also generated new mechanistic hypotheses, demonstrating how agentic discovery transfer can extend published findings beyond their original setting.
zh_abstract: 癌症研究每年产生数万项研究，但已发表的发现是否在另一种癌症类型或患者人群中成立却很少被检验，因为这样做劳动密集且难以规模化。我们将这一任务定义为发现迁移（discovery transfer），并提出SMART，一个用于单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）研究中发现迁移的多智能体大语言模型框架。给定源手稿和目标scRNA-seq数据集，SMART提取主要临床和机制发现，为可检验的发现生成并执行分析，报告哪些发现可迁移并提出后续研究建议。应用于六种癌症类型的121项研究，SMART识别出可跨癌症迁移的发现，包括一个肺癌预后特征，我们证实其与肝癌、胰腺癌和胸膜间皮瘤中的生存相关。SMART还生成了新的机制假设，展示智能体式发现迁移如何能够将已发表发现扩展到其原始背景之外。

title: PharmaAgent: a real-world evaluation of high- and low-autonomy agentic systems for inpatient vancomycin dosing

建议落在医嘱25%以内的比例分别为73.4%与50.9%
196条超容差建议中65.8%存在药师认定安全顾虑
reason: 真实院内静默部署+316例前瞻性数据+安全审查，但为预印本，属重要档偏下
abstract: Vancomycin has a narrow therapeutic window requiring individualized dosing and repeated monitoring, a process health systems delegate from physicians to pharmacists for consistency. We silently deployed PharmaAgent, LLM-based vancomycin dosing agentic systems, at Stanford Hospital for two months and compared high- and low-autonomy configurations, each with and without institutional guidelines. Across 403 dosing events in 316 patients, mean absolute percentage error against the treating pharmacist's order was 21.8% with high autonomy versus 37.8% with low autonomy, and recommendations were within 25% of the order in 73.4% versus 50.9% of events (P < 0.001); a second pharmacist was within 25% in 90.2%. Pharmacist review of 196 out-of-tolerance recommendations found a safety concern in 65.8%, more often with low autonomy (odds ratio 2.37). A higher-autonomy agent that self-debugged its intermediate steps proved more robust than stricter engineering, but neither configuration is ready to dose patients without pharmacist oversight.
zh_abstract: 万古霉素治疗窗窄，需要个体化给药和反复监测，为保持一致，医疗系统将该流程从医生委托给药师。我们在斯坦福医院静默部署了PharmaAgent——基于大语言模型（LLM）的万古霉素给药智能体系统——为期两个月，并比较了高自主性和低自主性配置，每种配置均在有和没有机构指南的情况下运行。在316名患者的403次给药事件中，相对于治疗药师医嘱的平均绝对百分比误差在高自主性下为21.8%，低自主性下为37.8%；建议与医嘱相差在25%以内的事件分别占73.4%和50.9%（P < 0.001）；第二位药师在90.2%的情况下相差在25%以内。药师审查了196条超出容差范围的建议，在65.8%中发现安全性顾虑，低自主性时更常见（比值比2.37）。一种能自我调试其中间步骤的更高自主性智能体被证明比更严格的工程化设计更稳健，但两种配置均尚未准备好在没有药师监督的情况下为患者给药。

title: QUARTZ: Cross-Dataset Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Retinal Vasculometry
zh_title: QUARTZ：跨数据集的视网膜血管测量AI
summary: QUARTZ是AI视网膜血管测量系统，利用NHS超400万张图像及26个标注数据集提升跨数据集泛化。

可分析部分照明等低质量图像

reason: 预印本但大规模影像与26数据集跨数据集验证，属重要档
abstract: Examination of retinal images provides a non-invasive means to assess the body's microvascular system, with vessel morphology linked to ocular and systemic diseases. QUARTZ (QUantitative Analysis of Retinal vessel Topology and siZe) is an automated, artificial intelligence-enabled retinal vasculometry system designed for processing large-scale retinal image datasets, including over 4 million images from within the National Health Service, to facilitate epidemiological studies. The system is uniquely capable of extracting useful information from lower quality images, including those which are partially illuminated, enabling analysis of a greater proportion of images. To enhance cross-dataset generalisation of the system from an earlier dataset-tailored approach, this work leverages 26 annotated retinal image datasets spanning diverse demographics, diseases, camera types, and imaging protocols. Evaluation on the external EPIC-Norfolk dataset demonstrates robust performance with F1 scores of 0.8305, 0.8477, 0.8741, 0.9532, and 0.8677 for arteriole, venule, vessel, optic disc, and optic cup segmentation, respectively, and 0.9197 for image quality classification. The cross-dataset generalisation approach demonstrated increased performance for arteriole/venule segmentation and optic disc segmentation. However, improvements in performance were not observed for optic cup segmentation, or for image quality classification. An online tool is provided to support wider adoption and reproducible biomarker research across diverse populations and imaging settings. In addition, the new public CHASE-AV database is introduced for arteriole and venule segmentation.
zh_abstract: 检查视网膜图像提供了一种非侵入性评估人体微血管系统的方法，血管形态与眼部和全身性疾病相关。QUARTZ（QUantitative Analysis of Retinal vessel Topology and siZe）是一种自动化、人工智能支持的视网膜血管测量系统，设计用于处理大规模视网膜图像数据集，包括来自英国国家卫生服务体系（National Health Service）的超过400万张图像，以促进流行病学研究。该系统具有独特能力，可从质量较低的图像中提取有用信息，包括部分照明的图像，从而能够分析更大比例的图像。为增强系统从早期针对数据集定制的方法向跨数据集泛化，本工作利用了26个带注释的视网膜图像数据集，涵盖不同人口统计学特征、疾病、相机类型和成像方案。在外部 EPIC-Norfolk 数据集上的评估显示出稳健性能，动脉小血管、静脉小血管、血管、视盘和视杯分割的 F1 分数分别为0.8305、0.8477、0.8741、0.9532和0.8677，图像质量分类的 F1 分数为0.9197。跨数据集泛化方法在动脉小血管/静脉小血管分割和视盘分割中表现出性能提升。然而，在视杯分割或图像质量分类中未观察到性能改善。提供了一个在线工具，以支持在不同人群和成像环境中的更广泛采用和可重复的生物标志物研究。此外，引入了新的公开 CHASE-AV 数据库，用于动脉小血管和静脉小血管分割。

title: Large Language Models for Accurate Medical Chart Abstraction: Enabling Scalable and Secure Artificial Intelligence Deployment in Stroke
zh_title: 大模型提取卒中报告临床变量：三院2416份报告评测
summary: 预印本研究用提示式LLM框架在三家医院2416份神经介入卒中报告中提取8个临床变量，并评测22个开源指令模型。

reason: 跨三家医院、两千余份报告并横向比较22个模型，属多中心外部评测，但为预印本
abstract: Medical chart abstraction transforms unstructured clinical narratives into structured variables for research and quality monitoring. We evaluated a prompting-based large language model (LLM) framework for extracting eight clinical variables from 2,416 neurointerventional acute stroke intervention reports across three hospitals. Twenty-two instruction-tuned open-source LLMs were evaluated across architectures, model sizes, and biomedical adaptations using Quick Response and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting. Non-expert staff annotations served as the cross-model reference standard. Evaluation was restricted to report-variable pairs with a valid LLaMA3.3-70B CoT prediction and a corresponding reference label. Performance measures included extraction accuracy, inference latency, and agreement with expert adjudication. Twenty discordant cases per variable underwent review by two senior physicians and four medical students. LLaMA3.3-70B achieved the highest overall accuracy (94.8%). CoT improved performance on inference-dependent variables such as site of occlusion, while Quick Response was optimal for directly stated procedural fields. Expert adjudication showed that AI predictions were more closely aligned with expert interpretations than non-expert annotations for most variables, with intracranial angioplasty remaining a challenge. Locally deployed LLMs can support scalable clinical information extraction and retrospective stroke registry curation, with expert oversight for ambiguous cases.
zh_abstract: 病历资料提取将非结构化临床叙述转化为结构化变量，用于研究和质量监测。我们评估了一个基于提示的大语言模型（LLM）框架，用于从来自三家医院的2,416份神经介入急性卒中干预报告中提取八个临床变量。我们使用快速响应（Quick Response）和思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）提示，跨架构、模型规模和生物医学适配评估了22个指令微调开源LLM。非专家工作人员标注作为跨模型参考标准。评估仅限于具有有效LLaMA3.3-70B CoT预测及相应参考标签的报告-变量对。性能指标包括提取准确率、推理延迟以及与专家裁决的一致性。每个变量20例不一致病例由两名资深医师和四名医学生复核。LLaMA3.3-70B取得最高总体准确率（94.8%）。CoT改善了依赖推理的变量（如闭塞部位）的性能，而快速响应对于直接陈述的手术字段最佳。专家裁决显示，对于大多数变量，AI预测比非专家标注更接近专家解释，颅内血管成形术仍是一项挑战。本地部署的LLM可支持可扩展的临床信息提取和回顾性卒中登记库整理，并对模糊病例进行专家监督。

title: AI/ML-enabled sepsis prediction systems: laboratory considerations from development to deployment.

abstract: [Journal of clinical microbiology] Sepsis prediction algorithms based on machine learning are increasingly embedded in electronic health record systems, and clinical laboratories have been largely absent from their development, validation, and governance. This is a consequential gap. Laboratory variables are central inputs to most deployed sepsis artificial intelligence (AI) tools, and routine analytical events such as platform transitions, reagent reformulations, and reference interval updates can shift the distributions of these inputs. Such distribution shifts are a recognized cause of degraded model performance; however, the effects of laboratory-specific changes remain insufficiently characterized for sepsis tools in clinical use. Neither clinical teams nor laboratories are currently well positioned to detect these effects. This review is written for clinical laboratorians who encounter these tools in practice or are asked to evaluate them for implementation. We describe the data sources used as model inputs and how analytical context, preanalytical variability, and ordering patterns influence model behavior. Five deployed algorithms with real-world implementation evidence are profiled alongside the broader preclinical landscape, including early warning systems, mortality and complication prediction models, and sepsis subtyping research. Development and implementation pitfalls are reviewed with attention to laboratory-specific considerations, and the regulatory and governance landscape is addressed with emphasis on where laboratorian involvement is most needed. Controlled outcomes data supporting currently deployed tools remain limited, and reported performance frequently does not replicate at external sites. Laboratorians bring expertise in analytical quality, data provenance, and change management that is not replicated elsewhere on implementation teams. As the field moves toward sepsis subtyping, continuous monitoring, and local model calibration, laboratorian expertise in analytical quality and monitoring will become increasingly central to how these tools are built, deployed, and maintained.
zh_abstract: [临床微生物学杂志（Journal of Clinical Microbiology）] 基于机器学习的脓毒症预测算法正日益嵌入电子健康记录系统，而临床实验室在其开发、验证和治理中基本缺席。这是一个重要的缺口。实验室变量是大多数已部署的脓毒症人工智能（AI）工具的核心输入，而平台转换、试剂配方变更和参考区间更新等常规分析事件可能改变这些输入的分布。此类分布偏移是模型性能下降的公认原因；然而，对于临床使用的脓毒症工具，实验室特有变化的影响仍未得到充分表征。目前，临床团队和实验室都没有处于能够检测这些影响的有利位置。本综述面向在实践中遇到这些工具或被要求评估其用于实施的临床检验人员。我们描述了用作模型输入的数据来源，以及分析背景、分析前变异和开单模式如何影响模型行为。本文介绍了五种具有真实世界实施证据的已部署算法，并概述更广泛的临床前研究格局，包括早期预警系统、死亡和并发症预测模型以及脓毒症亚型研究。我们回顾了开发与实施中的陷阱，重点关注实验室特有的考量，并讨论了监管和治理格局，强调最需要检验人员参与之处。支持当前已部署工具的对照结局数据仍然有限，且报告的性能常常无法在外部机构复现。检验人员在分析质量、数据溯源和变更管理方面带来的专业知识，是实施团队其他成员无法替代的。随着该领域迈向脓毒症亚型划分、持续监测和本地模型校准，检验人员在分析质量和监测方面的专业知识将越来越成为这些工具如何构建、部署和维护的核心。

abstract: [JAAPA : official journal of the American Academy of Physician Assistants] Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes, which record patient encounters and automatically draft clinical notes, are rapidly entering frontline practice. They rely on large language models to convert recorded conversations into structured documentation and are marketed as a way to reduce the documentation burden that contributes to clinician burnout. Early evidence from multicenter studies, randomized trials, systematic reviews, and international research suggests that ambient AI scribes may reduce documentation time and improve clinician well-being. However, most available studies are observational, reliant on small samples, and limited to short-term follow-up. At the same time, studies consistently raise concerns about new risks, including AI-generated "hallucinations" (fabricated content that appears confident), errors in draft notes (with omissions being the most common error type), documentation drift toward generic language, racial disparities in speech recognition accuracy, the use of unauthorized "shadow" AI tools with HIPAA and security implications, and unresolved questions about clinical safety outcomes. For physician associates (PAs), who are high-volume users of electronic health records and whose notes frequently serve as the primary communication channel with collaborating physicians, these risks carry particular weight. This review explains how ambient AI scribes work in accessible terms, synthesizes the current evidence base, and offers concrete strategies that PAs can use to ensure that these tools support safe, efficient, patient-centered practice.
zh_abstract: [JAAPA：美国医师助理学会官方期刊] 环境式人工智能（AI）记录员可记录患者就诊并自动起草临床记录，正迅速进入一线实践。它们依赖大语言模型将录制的对话转换为结构化文档，并被宣传为一种减轻文书负担（该负担会导致临床医生职业倦怠）的方式。来自多中心研究、随机试验、系统评价和国际研究的早期证据提示，环境式 AI 记录员可能减少文书时间并改善临床医生福祉。然而，大多数现有研究为观察性研究、依赖小样本且随访时间短。与此同时，研究持续提出对新风险的担忧，包括 AI 生成的“幻觉”（看似自信的虚构内容）、草稿记录中的错误（其中遗漏是最常见错误类型）、记录向泛化语言漂移、语音识别准确率中的种族差异、使用未经授权的“影子”AI 工具及其 HIPAA 和安全影响，以及关于临床安全结局的未解决问题。对于医师助理（physician associates, PAs）而言，这些风险尤为重要，因为他们是电子健康记录的高频使用者，且其记录常作为与协作医师沟通的主要渠道。本综述以通俗易懂的方式解释环境式 AI 记录员如何工作，综合当前证据基础，并提供 PAs 可使用的具体策略，以确保这些工具支持安全、高效、以患者为中心的实践。

title: Beyond a single ratio: an adaptable deep learning approach to analyze the prognostic value of TSP distribution in ovarian cancer.

abstract: [The Journal of pathology] The tumor-stroma percentage (TSP) has been proposed as a prognostic factor in ovarian cancer. When assessed manually by pathologists, the TSP can be subject to significant inter-rater variability. Automated methods for TSP determination have recently been developed. Existing approaches typically yield a single TSP value for a relatively small region of interest in the slide, introducing bias through region selection and potentially overlooking the TSP distribution across the entire histologically examined area. We present an adaptable deep learning pipeline, efficiently fine-tuned for ovarian cancer tissue analysis using a few-shot learning approach, requiring only minimal new training annotations. Instead of calculating a single TSP value, our method quantifies the global TSP distribution across the entire tumor and therefore captures its spatial heterogeneity. To identify a prognostic biomarker, we systematically evaluated a panel of metrics describing this distribution in 98 patients. Our analysis revealed that the mean-median difference of the TSP distribution [hazard ratio (HR) = 0.60, 95% CI = 0.46-0.79, p < 0.001], a quantitative measure of asymmetry, together with the mean TSP (HR = 0.65, 95% CI = 0.43-0.97, p = 0.03), are biomarkers significantly associated with recurrence-free survival. By successfully adapting a pipeline for ovarian cancer, we demonstrate that automated analysis of the entire TSP distribution provides significant prognostic information superior to that obtained by manual assessment. Spatial heterogeneity of the TSP is a key prognostic factor. © 2026 Fraunhofer IIS and The Author(s). zh_abstract: [The Journal of Pathology] 肿瘤-间质百分比（tumor-stroma percentage, TSP）已被提出作为卵巢癌的预后因素。由病理学家手动评估时，TSP可能存在显著的评估者间变异性。最近已开发出用于确定TSP的自动化方法。现有方法通常针对切片中相对较小的感兴趣区域给出单个TSP值，通过区域选择引入偏倚，并可能忽略整个组织学检查区域内的TSP分布。我们提出一种可适配的深度学习流程，使用少样本学习（few-shot learning）方法针对卵巢癌组织分析进行高效微调，仅需极少量新的训练标注。我们的方法不计算单个TSP值，而是量化整个肿瘤的全局TSP分布，因而捕捉其空间异质性。为识别预后生物标志物，我们在98例患者中系统评估了一组描述该分布的指标。我们的分析显示，TSP分布的均值-中位数差[风险比（HR）= 0.60，95% CI = 0.46-0.79，p < 0.001]——一种不对称性的定量指标——连同平均TSP（HR = 0.65，95% CI = 0.43-0.97，p = 0.03），是与无复发生存显著相关的生物标志物。通过成功适配针对卵巢癌的流程，我们证明对整个TSP分布的自动化分析提供了显著的预后信息，优于手动评估所获得的信息。TSP的空间异质性是一个关键预后因素。© 2026 Fraunhofer IIS 与作者。The Journal of Pathology 由 John Wiley & Sons Ltd 代表 The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland 出版。

abstract: [Current opinion in neurology] Artificial intelligence (AI) is being increasingly integrated into upper-limb, language and cognitive neurorehabilitation research and there is interest in where the research currently lies along the pipeline towards clinical implementation and real-world impact. Across these three domains of neurorehabilitation, the research into the use of AI has shown clear potential to enhance assessment, personalize rehabilitation and extend access to care but is yet to demonstrate clinical utility and superiority over other digital rehabilitation approaches. There remain concerns about small and selective datasets being used for modelling, privacy and equity issues and sustainable implementation. It is suggested that AI should be positioned as an important tool in the clinical infrastructure rather than an autonomous clinical decision maker within clinical practice. Future research across these neurorehabilitation domains should consider implementation risks and needs early in the research pipeline, by using ethical principles and guidelines to ensure transparency and consumer involvement in AI research and implementation into clinical practice.

abstract: [International journal of radiation oncology, biology, physics] Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) are driving a major shift in modern medicine, particularly within radiation oncology. AI in radiation oncology offers low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) a way to offset critical shortages of oncologists and physicists by automating segmentation, planning, and quality checks, improving efficiency, and expanding equitable access to care. Its actual value depends on validation against LMICs' infrastructure and patient populations, an area where current evidence remains limited. This review aims to comprehensively summarize the current evidence on AI and ML applications across key domains of radiotherapy, while highlighting global disparities in adoption, particularly in LMICs. This critical review conducted a comprehensive literature search across PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library for studies published between 2010 and April 2026. Only relevant studies emphasizing the efficiency of AI in radiation workflow and the existing gaps in its adoption within LMICs were included in this review. Eleven studies published between 2019 and 2025 were included. Study designs comprised original research (n=5), reviews (n=4), a survey (n=1), and a study protocol (n=1). Studies were conducted across multiple LMICs in Africa, Asia, and Latin America, predominantly evaluating AI-based contouring and treatment-planning tools, with Radiation Planning Assistant (RPA) being the most frequently reported platform. AI tools demonstrated comparable performance in LMICs relative to High-Income Countries (HICs), particularly with regard to time efficiency and the quality of target volume contouring. Yet the majority of LMICs still don't have AI tools in their radiation centers to work efficiently. The current literature reveals a gap between the need for AI in radiation oncology in LMICs and the available evidence supporting its implementation. LMICs could benefit substantially from AI-enabled improvements in radiation oncology. Several conclusions about the applicability of these findings in LMIC settings were drawn by extrapolation from studies conducted in HIC contexts, which substantially limits their direct generalizability to lower-resource environments. Cost-effective and accessible AI models hold promise to address workforce shortages, improve efficiency, and expand equitable access to quality radiotherapy services.
zh_abstract: [International journal of radiation oncology, biology, physics] 人工智能（Artificial Intelligence, AI）和机器学习（Machine Learning, ML）正在推动现代医学的重大转变，尤其是在放射肿瘤学领域。放射肿瘤学中的AI为低收入和中等收入国家（low- and middle-income countries, LMICs）提供了一种方式，通过自动化分割、计划和质量检查，提高效率并扩大公平获得医疗照护的机会，从而抵消肿瘤科医生和物理师的严重短缺。其实际价值取决于针对LMICs的基础设施和患者人群进行验证，而当前证据在这一领域仍然有限。本综述旨在全面总结AI和ML在放射治疗关键领域中应用的当前证据，同时强调全球采用方面的差异，尤其是在LMICs中。本批判性综述在PubMed、Embase和Cochrane Library中进行了全面文献检索，检索2010年至2026年4月间发表的研究。本综述仅纳入强调AI在放射工作流程中的效率以及LMICs中采用现有差距的相关研究。共纳入2019年至2025年间发表的11项研究。研究设计包括原创研究（n=5）、综述（n=4）、调查（n=1）和研究方案（n=1）。研究在非洲、亚洲和拉丁美洲的多个LMICs中开展，主要评估基于AI的勾画和治疗计划工具，其中放射治疗计划助手（Radiation Planning Assistant, RPA）是最常报告的平台。AI工具在LMICs中表现出相对于高收入国家（High-Income Countries, HICs）相当的性能，尤其是在时间效率和靶区勾画质量方面。然而，大多数LMICs的放射治疗中心仍然没有AI工具来高效工作。当前文献揭示了LMICs放射肿瘤学对AI的需求与支持其实施的现有证据之间存在差距。LMICs可能从AI赋能的放射肿瘤学改进中显著受益。关于这些发现对LMIC环境适用性的若干结论是通过从HIC背景下开展的研究进行外推得出的，这显著限制了其对低资源环境的直接普适性。具有成本效益且可及的AI模型有望解决 workforce 短缺、提高效率并扩大公平获得高质量放射治疗服务的机会。

While many types of models have proliferated across healthcare and the life sciences, systematic, rapid generation of multi-condition predictions of diagnoses, future medical events and future clinical outcomes from a single foundation-model architecture remains rare. This paper describes the implementation of PhenOM to complete a vast number of predictive tasks across clinical domains and outcomes. Methods. abstract: In-context learning (ICL), the ability to perform new tasks from a few examples supplied in a prompt, is a defining emergent capability of large language models. Here, we show that ICL emerges in the genome language model Evo 2 and enables biological design. With as few as four examples in the prompt and no additional training, Evo 2 generates realistic metal-binding proteins, de novo antibodies, protein-RNA systems, and entire bacteriophage genomes. For {Phi}X174-like bacteriophage design, ICL surpasses previously fine-tuned models on computational measures of design quality and diversity. Beyond {Phi}X174, conditioning the model with different phage prompts enables us to efficiently design MS2 and M13 genomes in silico without fine-tuning. Iteratively updating the prompt with newly generated phage genomes, which we refer to as genomic chain-of-thought, further improves the diversity of designs while maintaining quality metrics. Paired with an inference engine that accelerates generation up to 35-fold and extends practicable context to a megabase, these results establish ICL as a versatile and efficient paradigm for biological sequence design.
zh_abstract: 上下文学习（in-context learning, ICL）是指根据提示中提供的少量示例执行新任务的能力，是大语言模型一种标志性的涌现能力。在此，我们表明 ICL 在基因组语言模型 Evo 2 中涌现，并能够实现生物设计。仅需提示中的四个示例且无需额外训练，Evo 2 就能生成逼真的金属结合蛋白、从头抗体、蛋白质-RNA 系统以及完整的噬菌体基因组。对于 {Phi}X174 样噬菌体设计，ICL 在设计质量和多样性的计算指标上超过了先前经过微调的模型。除 {Phi}X174 外，用不同的噬菌体提示对模型进行条件化，使我们无需微调即可在计算机中高效设计 MS2 和 M13 基因组。用新生成的噬菌体基因组迭代更新提示（我们称之为基因组思维链），进一步提高了设计的多样性，同时保持质量指标。结合可将生成速度提升最高 35 倍并将可用上下文扩展到 1 兆碱基（megabase）的推理引擎，这些结果确立了 ICL 作为一种通用且高效的生物序列设计范式。

title: Multi-modal data Integration for Metastatic Risk Prediction of AJCC Stage I/II Melanomas: Results from the Population-based Dutch Early-stage Melanoma Study (D-ESMEL)
zh_title: 多模态数据整合预测早期黑色素瘤转移
summary: D-ESMEL研究整合临床病理、基因组、转录组与病理组学数据，预测Ⅰ/Ⅱ期黑色素瘤转移风险并比较四种整合策略。
key_points: 发现集221组、验证集154组匹配病例
比较四种多模态数据整合策略
涵盖临床病理、基因组、转录组与病理组学
reason: 预印本，含独立验证集与多种整合策略比较，但样本为匹配病例对照
abstract: Early-stage melanoma accounts for 40-60% of melanoma-related deaths. Most prognostic modelling studies focus on unimodal approaches or a single multimodal integration strategy, overlooking alternative methods and biological processes underlying metastatic progression. We aimed to evaluate multi-modal data integration for predicting metastasis using the Dutch Early-Stage Melanoma (D-ESMEL) study, the world's largest multi-modal cohort of American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) stage I/II melanoma. We analysed clinicopathological, genomic, transcriptomic, and pathomics data from the D-ESMEL study. The discovery set included 221 case-control sets matched on follow-up time, age, sex, Breslow thickness, and ulceration. The validation cohort included 154 AJCC stage matched case-control sets based on a population of >5,500 stage I/II melanoma patients. We evaluated four integration strategies (early, intermediate, mixed, and late) using a repeated (n=5) nested 3-fold cross-validation in the discovery set. The best-performing models were evaluated in the validation cohort using the odds ratios (ORs) and a weighted C-index reflecting performance in the sampled population. In the discovery set, intermediate integration of genomics and transcriptomics achieved the highest balanced accuracy (mean: 0.62; 95% CI: 0.57-0.66). Early and late integration of transcriptomics and pathomics, and the unimodal transcriptomics model showed similar performance (mean: 0.61; 95% CI: 0.58-0.65). In the validation cohort both early integration, late integration, and the unimodal transcriptomics model achieved the highest balanced accuracy of 0.60. When adjusted for clinicopathological risk factors early integration remained an independent prognostic factor for metastasis (OR 1.75; p<0.01), outperforming transcriptomics alone (OR 1.26; p<0.01). Early integration reached a weighted C-index of 0.83 outperforming AJCC stage (0.81 C-index). When combined the population-weighted C-index was significantly improved to 0.85 (p<0.01). Early integration of transcriptomics and pathomics outperformed all unimodal models and improved prediction of distant metastasis independently of AJCC stage. Understanding the biological mechanisms underlying these predictions may further support clinical decision-making.
zh_abstract: 早期黑色素瘤占黑色素瘤相关死亡的40-60%。大多数预后建模研究聚焦于单模态方法或单一多模态整合策略，忽视了其他方法以及转移进展背后的生物学过程。我们旨在利用荷兰早期黑色素瘤（D-ESMEL）研究——全球最大的美国癌症联合委员会（AJCC）I/II期黑色素瘤多模态队列——评估多模态数据整合对转移的预测。我们分析了D-ESMEL研究的临床病理学、基因组学、转录组学和病理组学数据。发现集包括221个病例-对照集，按随访时间、年龄、性别、Breslow厚度和溃疡进行匹配。验证队列包括154个AJCC分期匹配的病例-对照集，基于超过5,500例I/II期黑色素瘤患者的人群。我们在发现集中使用重复（n=5）嵌套3折交叉验证评估了四种整合策略（早期、中期、混合和晚期）。表现最佳的模型在验证队列中使用比值比（ORs）和反映抽样人群表现的加权C指数进行评估。在发现集中，基因组学和转录组学的中期整合取得了最高的平衡准确度（均值：0.62；95% CI：0.57-0.66）。转录组学和病理组学的早期与晚期整合，以及单模态转录组学模型表现出相似的表现（均值：0.61；95% CI：0.58-0.65）。在验证队列中，早期整合、晚期整合和单模态转录组学模型均达到最高的平衡准确度0.60。当对临床病理学危险因素进行调整后，早期整合仍是转移的独立预后因素（OR 1.75；p<0.01），优于单独转录组学（OR 1.26；p<0.01）。早期整合达到加权C指数0.83，优于AJCC分期（C指数0.81）。联合时，人群加权C指数显著提高至0.85（p<0.01）。转录组学和病理组学的早期整合优于所有单模态模型，并独立于AJCC分期改善远处转移预测。理解这些预测背后的生物学机制可能进一步支持临床决策。

title: Photograph-Based Skeletal Malocclusion Screening with Geometric Machine Learning: External Validation Across Turkish and Non-European Cohorts
zh_title: 照片几何特征筛查骨骼性错颌并外部验证
summary: 研究用侧面智能手机照片的几何特征构建错颌筛查模型，并在土耳其和非欧洲独立队列外部验证。
key_points: 输入为100维几何特征，无需放射影像
两个外部队列不参与模型训练
以敏感性、特异性和AUC为主要指标
reason: 预印本但有独立外部队列验证，证据有限未达重要档
abstract: A photograph based screening classifier for skeletal malocclusion maps 100 engineered geometric feature vectors, derived from a side-profile smartphone photograph, to orthodontic class labels, enabling non-invasive triage without radiographic imaging. This study reports external validation across two independent cohorts that contributed no cases to training. Two binary tasks were evaluated; Class III against non-Class III, and Class I against Class II; each with its own development set and model, applied without modification at the default threshold. One external cohort was Turkish, drawn from an institution not represented in the development set; the other was a non-European cohort from a Belgian private orthodontic clinic. Sensitivity, specificity and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) were pre-specified as primary outcome measures, since none depends on outcome prevalence. In the Class III task, sensitivity was similar across all three evaluation sets (0.801, 0.836, 0.848; all adjusted p>0.7), while specificity fell from 0.766 in the Turkish external cohort to 0.697 in the non-European cohort. AUC was 0.902 and 0.835 respectively (difference 0.066; p=0.029). In the Class I and Class II task the corresponding values were 0.875 and 0.723 (difference 0.152; p<0.001). A subgroup analysis showed lower sensitivity in children than adults across both cohorts (0.71 to 0.80 versus 0.89 to 0.90). AUC was lower in the non-European cohort for all three models in both tasks. The observed performance differences are consistent with a population-specific generalizability effect rather than model-specific failure and support mandatory external validation on target populations before clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: 一种基于照片的筛查分类器将100个工程化几何特征向量（由智能手机侧面照片推导而来）映射到正畸分类标签，从而无需放射学成像即可实现非侵入性分诊。本研究报告在两个独立队列中的外部验证，这两个队列均未贡献任何训练病例。评估了两项二分类任务：Class III 对非 Class III，以及 Class I 对 Class II；每项任务均有各自的开发集和模型，并在默认阈值下未经修改地应用。一个外部队列为土耳其队列，来自开发集中未代表的机构；另一个为非欧洲队列，来自比利时一家私立正畸诊所。敏感性、特异性和受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）被预先指定为主要结局指标，因为三者均不依赖于结局患病率。在 Class III 任务中，三个评估集的敏感性相似（0.801、0.836、0.848；所有校正后 p>0.7），而特异性从土耳其外部队列的0.766降至非欧洲队列的0.697。AUC分别为0.902和0.835（差异0.066；p=0.029）。在 Class I 和 Class II 任务中，相应值分别为0.875和0.723（差异0.152；p<0.001）。亚组分析显示，在两个队列中儿童敏感性均低于成人（0.71至0.80 对 0.89至0.90）。在两个任务中，非欧洲队列的所有三个模型AUC均较低。观察到的性能差异与人群特异性泛化效应一致，而非模型特异性失败，并支持在临床部署前对目标人群进行强制外部验证。

title: Disparity Laundering: Consensus Without Fairness in Clinical Multi-Agent Systems
zh_title: 临床多智能体系统的差异难以消除
summary: 在120例MIMIC-IV急诊病例的反事实测试中，5个模型家族与4种聚合拓扑的组合均未消除分诊差异，偏见只是被转移。
key_points: 20种模型与拓扑组合全部保留原有差异
公平指令与人口学遮蔽未缩小差距
逐智能体自我去偏反而扩大差距
reason: 预印本，公平性实验设计系统但病例数有限，无外部验证
abstract: Clinical large language models are increasingly fielded as multi-agent teams, on the assumption that deliberation averages out individual error. It does not average out bias. Across a full factorial of five model families and four aggregation topologies on 120 real MIMIC-IV emergency cases under counterfactual demographic swaps, no configuration neutralizes the disparity: all 20 cells commit the direction of their agents' independent answers, giving Black patients more acute triage. Every model has a topology that amplifies its baseline gap, but which one varies by model, so no design is reliably safe or reliably amplifying: the disparity is relocated, never removed. Late-stage fixes fail: fairness instructions and demographic masking leave the gap untouched, and per-agent self-debiasing widens it, because the bias is already encoded in the agents' ordinary clinical numbers. We call this disparity laundering; the audits now applied to clinical AI, per model, per output, per version, can certify the parts but never the committed decision. Interventions close the gap exactly when they make counterfactual versions visible inside the system and pool them, through deliberation, into the committed decision. A diverse-perspective ensemble does both while keeping the team, with no retraining or architectural change: the disparity falls by 67 to 94% where all five perspectives pool at every round, and the one topology that never pools them is the one it cannot reliably repair. Medical multi-agent systems do not filter demographic bias; they launder it into plausible decisions no single-version audit can catch, and the only defense is to make the bias visible.
zh_abstract: 临床大型语言模型正越来越多地以多智能体团队形式部署，其假设是审议能够平均掉个体错误。它并不能平均掉偏见。在反事实人口统计学交换下，对120例真实MIMIC-IV急诊病例进行五个模型家族与四种聚合拓扑结构的全因子设计，没有任何配置能消除差异：全部20个组合都沿袭其各智能体独立答案的方向，使黑人患者获得更紧急的分诊。每个模型都有一种会放大其基线差距的拓扑结构，但具体是哪一种因模型而异，因此没有一种设计能可靠地保证安全或可靠地产生放大作用：差异只是被转移，从未被消除。后期修复失败：公平性指令和人口统计学遮蔽使差距保持不变，而每个智能体的自我去偏会扩大差距，因为偏见已经编码在智能体的普通临床数值中。我们将此称为差异洗白（disparity laundering）；目前应用于临床AI的审计，按模型、按输出、按版本，可以认证各个部分，却永远无法认证最终提交的决策。干预措施只有在使反事实版本在系统内部可见，并通过审议将它们汇总进最终提交的决策时，才能恰好弥合差距。多样化视角集成在不进行再训练或架构改变的情况下保留了团队形式并同时做到这两点：在所有五个视角在每一轮都汇总的情况下，差异下降67%至94%，而唯一从不汇总这些视角的拓扑结构，正是它无法可靠修复的那一种。医疗多智能体系统并不过滤人口统计学偏见；它们将其洗白为看似合理的决策，任何单一版本审计都无法发现，而唯一的防御是让偏见可见。

title: Multi-resolution humanness scoring of antibodies via a region-isolated language model
zh_title: IgScope：分区打分的抗体人源化语言模型
summary: 研究者构建2300万参数抗体语言模型IgScope，可在链、IMGT区域与残基层面评估序列的人源化程度。
key_points: 区域隔离注意力仅关注区域内残基对
嵌合序列训练提供区域级监督
在238万条留出链上遮蔽框架区不影响CDR准确率
reason: 预印本新模型，评测规模较大且有基线比较，但未见外部实验验证
abstract: Antibodies recognized as foreign can elicit anti-drug antibodies that compromise efficacy and safety, making humanness scoring---estimating how human-like a sequence appears---an early, repeated step in antibody development. Widely used scores reduce a variable domain to one framework-dominated number, leaving the complementarity-determining regions (CDRs)---grafted during humanization, diversified by generative models---weakly supervised and rarely audited. Here we introduce IgScope, a 23-million-parameter antibody language model trained from scratch that scores humanness at chain, IMGT-region and residue resolution; a region-isolated attention module confines attention to within-region pairs, and chimeric-sequence training supplies region-level supervision. On 2.38 million held-out chains, masking all framework tokens leaves CDR accuracy unchanged, and back-mutated murine residues in human frameworks are detected at 93.4% accuracy. At chain level, IgScope matches the strongest published correlation with clinical anti-drug-antibody incidence (r = $-$0.567, n = 217) and outperforms a same-protocol recomputation. Region-level scoring exposes what chain-level scoring conceals: antibodies designed de novo by four generative models pass whole-chain humanness (0.966--0.988) while their CDRs score far below natural (P $<$ 1e-30) in every chain class. Quality control turns the same resolution to the mirror-image question: in humanized-mouse platforms, whose domains are human by design, IgScope scores the domain as human and, in HUGO-Nano chimeric VHHs, isolates only the FR2 signal of four camelid hallmark residues deliberately retained to stabilise the VHH. IgScope gives antibody humanization a verified foundation and generative design an audit.
zh_abstract: 被识别为外来的抗体可引发抗药物抗体，从而损害疗效和安全性，这使得人源性评分——估计序列看起来有多像人源——成为抗体开发中早期且重复的步骤。广泛使用的评分将可变结构域简化为一个由框架主导的数字，使互补决定区（CDRs）——在人源化过程中被移植、由生成模型多样化——处于弱监督状态且很少被审计。在此我们介绍IgScope，一个从零训练的2300万参数抗体语言模型，可在链、IMGT区域和残基分辨率上对人源性进行评分；区域隔离注意力模块将注意力限制在区域内配对，嵌合序列训练提供区域级监督。在238万条留出链上，遮蔽所有框架token后CDR准确度保持不变，且人源框架中回突变的鼠源残基以93.4%的准确度被检出。在链水平上，IgScope与临床抗药物抗体发生率的已发表最强相关性相当（r = -0.567，n = 217），并优于同方案重计算。区域级评分揭示了链级评分所掩盖的内容：由四个生成模型从头设计的抗体通过全链人源性评分（0.966-0.988），而其CDRs在每个链类别中的评分都远低于天然（P < 1e-30）。质量控制将同样的分辨率转向镜像问题：在人源化小鼠平台中，其结构域按设计为人源，IgScope将该结构域评分为人源；而在HUGO-Nano嵌合VHH中，它仅分离出四个骆驼科标志性残基的FR2信号，这些残基是为稳定VHH而有意保留的。IgScope为抗体人源化提供了经过验证的基础，并为生成式设计提供了审计手段。

title: Artificial intelligence in antiviral drug discovery: Data resources, methods, and applications.
source: PubMed · European journal of medicinal chemistry
zh_title: AI在抗病毒药物发现中的数据与方法
summary: 综述梳理AI辅助抗病毒药物发现的数据资源、代表性方法与应用任务。
key_points: 汇总病毒基因组、蛋白、化合物活性等数据库
梳理抗病毒药物发现关键任务的AI方法
指出广谱与高耐药屏障药物的需求
reason: 同行评审综述，信息有组织但属综述档，最高6分
abstract: [European journal of medicinal chemistry] Viral infectious diseases remain a major global health burden, underscoring the urgent need for efficient strategies to identify novel antiviral agents, particularly those with broad-spectrum activity and a high barrier to resistance. With the rapid accumulation of diverse biological and chemical data, artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being integrated into antiviral drug discovery to accelerate candidate identification and optimization. In this review, we summarize major data resources for AI-assisted antiviral research, including viral genome databases, viral protein databases, virus-host protein interaction databases, antiviral compound activity databases, compound structure databases, and viral mutation and drug resistance databases. We then review representative AI methods and applications across key tasks in antiviral drug discovery, including target-based drug discovery, phenotype-based drug discovery, and viral mutation and drug resistance prediction. We also summarize representative antiviral candidates from AI-assisted studies and their reported activities. Finally, we discuss current challenges and future opportunities in AI-assisted antiviral drug discovery. We believe that the continued advances in data resources and AI methodologies will accelerate the development of more effective antiviral agents.
zh_abstract: [European journal of medicinal chemistry] 病毒性传染病仍是全球主要健康负担，凸显了迫切需要高效策略来识别新型抗病毒药物，尤其是具有广谱活性和高耐药屏障的药物。随着多样化的生物学和化学数据快速积累，人工智能（AI）正日益被整合到抗病毒药物发现中，以加速候选药物的识别和优化。在本综述中，我们总结了用于AI辅助抗病毒研究的主要数据资源，包括病毒基因组数据库、病毒蛋白数据库、病毒-宿主蛋白相互作用数据库、抗病毒化合物活性数据库、化合物结构数据库以及病毒突变与耐药数据库。随后，我们综述了抗病毒药物发现关键任务中的代表性AI方法与应用，包括基于靶点的药物发现、基于表型的药物发现以及病毒突变与耐药预测。我们还总结了AI辅助研究中具有代表性的抗病毒候选药物及其报告的活性。最后，我们讨论了AI辅助抗病毒药物发现中的当前挑战和未来机遇。我们相信，数据资源和AI方法的持续进步将加速更有效抗病毒药物的开发。

title: GeoMind: Dancing with Geometric Brain Rhythm on Symmetric Positive Definite Manifolds.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
zh_title: GeoMind：SPD流形上的几何脑节律建模
summary: IEEE TMI提出GeoMind，在对称正定流形上以状态空间模型刻画脑功能连接动态演化。
key_points: 以状态空间模型刻画脑状态间转换机制
在黎曼流形上建模功能连接的SPD几何结构
面向功能神经影像的动态脑状态分析
reason: 方法学单篇，缺乏外部验证与性能对比信息，属增量档
abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] State space model (SSM) is a powerful tool in neuroscience field to characterize the dynamic nature of brain functions by elucidating the mechanism of how brain system transits between brain states and how underlying states give rise to the observed neural activities. Although tremendous efforts have been made to lend the power of deep learning and mathematical insight of SSM in various functional neuroimaging studies, current state-of-the-art methods lack a holistic view of brain state evolution as a self-organized dynamical system where each part of the brain is functionally inter-connected. Since the topological co-activation of functional fluctuations exhibits an intrinsic geometric pattern (symmetric and positive definite, SPD) on the Riemannian manifold, the call for understanding how a selective set of functional connectivities in the brain supports diverse behavior and cognition emerge a new machine learning scenario of manifold-based SSM for largescale functional neuroimages. To that end, we propose a geometric neural network of SSM, coined GeoMind, designed to uncover evolving brain states by tracking the trajectory of functional dynamics on a high-dimensional Riemannian manifold of SPD matrices. GeoMind demonstrates promising results in identifying specific brain states on task-based functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) data, as well as in diseases early diagnosis for Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease and Autism, by using resting-state fMRI. These results highlight the applicability of GeoMind in neuroscience research. To further evaluate generalizability of GeoMind, we applied GeoMind to electroencephalography (EEG) emotion datasets, outperforming competing methods and demonstrating scalability across neuroimaging modalities.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 状态空间模型（state space model, SSM）是神经科学领域的有力工具，可通过阐明大脑系统如何在脑状态之间转换以及潜在状态如何产生观察到的神经活动，来刻画脑功能的动态特性。尽管已在各种功能神经影像研究中投入巨大努力，以借助深度学习和 SSM 的数学洞见，但当前最先进的方法缺乏将脑状态演化视为一个自组织动力系统的整体视角，其中大脑的每个部分在功能上相互连接。由于功能波动的拓扑共激活在黎曼流形上表现出内在的几何模式（对称正定，symmetric and positive definite, SPD），理解大脑中一组选择性功能连接如何支持多样行为与认知的需求，催生了面向大规模功能神经影像的基于流形的 SSM 这一新的机器学习场景。为此，我们提出一种 SSM 的几何神经网络，命名为 GeoMind，旨在通过追踪 SPD 矩阵的高维黎曼流形上功能动力学的轨迹来揭示演化中的脑状态。GeoMind 在基于任务态功能磁共振成像（functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging, fMRI）数据识别特定脑状态方面，以及利用静息态 fMRI 对阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和自闭症进行疾病早期诊断方面，均展现出有前景的结果。这些结果凸显了 GeoMind 在神经科学研究中的适用性。为进一步评估 GeoMind 的泛化性，我们将 GeoMind 应用于脑电图（electroencephalography, EEG）情绪数据集，其表现优于竞争方法，并展示了跨神经影像模态的可扩展性。

abstract: [Computer methods in biomechanics and biomedical engineering] Finite element analysis (FEA) is widely used to evaluate dental implant biomechanics but is computationally demanding. This study explores deep learning surrogate models for accurate stress prediction with limited data. A neural network was pre-trained on standard implant simulations (N = 3000) and adapted to narrow-diameter implants in atrophic bone (N = 200). Negative transfer occurred with extremely limited data (N = 20) due to biomechanical domain shift. However, both transfer learning and standard training achieved high accuracy at N ≥ 60 (R² = 0.94). This framework enables rapid, data-efficient biomechanical prediction for dental implant modeling.

abstract: [Journal of neuroradiology = Journal de neuroradiologie] Accurate compensation for intra-operative brain shift remains a fundamental challenge in neurosurgical procedures, as misalignment between pre-operative and intra-operative images can lead to suboptimal surgical guidance. In this work, we propose a bidirectional, unsupervised 3D brain shift compensation framework for non-rigid MRI registration, designed to directly estimate dense deformation fields between pre-operative and intra-operative volumes. The proposed approach employs dual image-translation pathways coupled with a dedicated deformation field predictor, enabling robust alignment without requiring paired training data. A key component of the framework is the integration of bidirectional consistency constraints to enforce anatomical correspondence across domains, while deformation field estimation is explicitly optimized for registration accuracy. In addition, we incorporate a Haar wavelet-based perceptual similarity (HaarPSI) loss to improve the preservation of fine-scale anatomical structures during registration. The proposed method is evaluated against classical and state-of-the-art baselines, including Elastix, Voxelmorph, and several adversarial and GAN-based learning approaches adapted with comparable registration modules. Qualitative analyses of deformation fields and error maps further demonstrate improved alignment in regions most affected by brain shift. These results highlight the effectiveness of bidirectional deformation modeling combined with adversarial and perceptual constraints for accurate, physically plausible, and unsupervised 3D non-rigid registration in neurosurgical applications.
zh_abstract: 《Journal of neuroradiology = Journal de neuroradiologie》术中脑移位的准确补偿仍然是神经外科手术中的一项基本挑战，因为术前与术中图像之间的错位可能导致次优的手术引导。在本工作中，我们提出了一种用于非刚性MRI配准的双向、无监督三维脑移位补偿框架，旨在直接估计术前与术中体积之间的密集变形场。所提方法采用双图像转换通路，并结合专用的变形场预测器，从而无需配对训练数据即可实现稳健对齐。该框架的一个关键组成部分是整合双向一致性约束，以强制跨域的解剖对应关系，同时针对配准精度显式优化变形场估计。此外，我们引入基于Haar小波的感知相似性（HaarPSI）损失，以改善配准过程中细尺度解剖结构的保持。所提方法针对经典和最先进的基线进行了评估，包括Elastix、Voxelmorph，以及若干采用可比配准模块进行适配的对抗式和基于GAN的学习方法。对变形场和误差图的定性分析进一步表明，在受脑移位影响最大的区域中对齐得到改善。这些结果突出了双向变形建模与对抗约束和感知约束相结合，在神经外科应用中实现准确、物理上合理且无监督的三维非刚性配准的有效性。

abstract: [Canadian journal of psychiatry. Revue canadienne de psychiatrie] Plain Language SummaryHow Artificial Intelligence Could Improve Psychiatric Drug DevelopmentDeveloping new medicines for mental health conditions is difficult, expensive, and often unsuccessful. One reason is that people with the same diagnosis can differ greatly in their underlying biology and in how they respond to treatment. Clinical trials also rely heavily on symptom ratings and can be affected by placebo responses. This editorial explains how artificial intelligence (AI) could help at several stages of psychiatric drug development. AI can help researchers identify promising drug targets, design new treatment molecules, and use biological, brain-imaging, and clinical data to predict treatment response and improve clinical trials. Emerging approaches include digital twins, synthetic control groups, and digital measures of symptoms and behaviour. However, these technologies are still developing and should not be viewed as a solution to all the challenges of psychiatric drug development. Wider use will require representative datasets, strong data governance, transparent and interpretable models, rigorous clinical validation, and appropriate regulation.

Revue canadienne de psychiatrie] 【通俗语言摘要】人工智能如何改善精神科药物研发。开发治疗精神健康问题的新药困难、昂贵，且常常不成功。原因之一是，诊断相同的人在其潜在生物学和治疗方法反应上可能差异很大。临床试验也高度依赖症状评分，并可能受到安慰剂反应的影响。本社论解释了人工智能（AI）如何在精神科药物研发的多个阶段提供帮助。AI可以帮助研究人员识别有前景的药物靶点、设计新的治疗分子，并利用生物学、脑成像和临床数据预测治疗反应并改进临床试验。新兴方法包括数字孪生、合成对照组以及症状和行为的数字测量。然而，这些技术仍在发展中，不应被视为解决精神科药物研发所有挑战的方案。更广泛的应用将需要具有代表性的数据集、强有力的数据治理、透明且可解释的模型、严格的临床验证以及适当的监管。

abstract: [Primary health care research & development] The rapid adoption of AI tools in academic research has created uncertainty about appropriate use in manuscript preparation, particularly in primary health care where clear guidance is essential for maintaining research integrity across diverse settings. This review aimed to assess the availability and content of AI policies across primary health care journals and their publishers. We identified primary health care journals through searches of SCImago Journal & Country Rank, Google Scholar, and a Google search. After screening for English language, functioning webpages, recent publications, and exclusion of predatory journals, 41 journals were included. Two reviewers independently reviewed journal homepages, author guidelines, submission policies, and editorial policies for AI-related statements at both journal and publisher levels between 18 and 21 July 2025. Of 41 journals assessed, 33 (80.5%) had publicly available AI policies - 21 (51.2%) at journal level and 12 (29.3%) at publisher level. Eight journals (19.5%) had no identifiable public AI policy. All identified policies were permissive toward AI use but varied in requirements across five key areas: disclosure of AI use, acceptable AI tasks, AI authorship considerations, author responsibility, and peer review guidelines. While most primary health care journals have established AI policies, significant gaps remain in accessibility and standardization. The fragmented governance landscape, characterized by inconsistent policy locations and requirements, creates confusion for authors and might compromise research integrity. Standardized, easily accessible AI policies are needed to enable researchers to harness AI's potential while maintaining transparency and scientific rigour essential to primary health care research.
zh_abstract: [Primary Health Care Research & Development] 学术研究中AI工具的快速采用给稿件准备中的适当使用带来了不确定性，尤其是在初级卫生保健领域，明确的指导对于在不同环境中维护研究诚信至关重要。本综述旨在评估初级卫生保健期刊及其出版商的AI政策的可获取性和内容。我们通过检索SCImago Journal & Country Rank、Google Scholar和Google搜索来识别初级卫生保健期刊。在筛选英语、网页可正常访问、近期发表出版物并排除掠夺性期刊后，纳入41种期刊。两名评审员在2025年7月18日至21日期间独立审查了期刊主页、作者指南、投稿政策和编辑政策中期刊层面和出版商层面的AI相关声明。在评估的41种期刊中，33种（80.5%）有公开可获取的AI政策——21种（51.2%）在期刊层面，12种（29.3%）在出版商层面。8种期刊（19.5%）没有可识别的公开AI政策。所有识别出的政策均对AI使用持允许态度，但在五个关键领域的要求各不相同：AI使用披露、可接受的AI任务、AI作者身份考量、作者责任和同行评审指南。尽管大多数初级卫生保健期刊已建立AI政策，但在可获取性和标准化方面仍存在显著差距。碎片化的治理格局以政策位置和要求不一致为特征，给作者造成困惑，并可能损害研究诚信。需要标准化、易于获取的AI政策，使研究人员能够利用AI的潜力，同时保持初级卫生保健研究至关重要的透明度和科学严谨性。

abstract: [Magma (New York, N.Y.)] Quantitative MRI has been held back, because it increases scan time on top of clinical protocols. In this cross-sectional study, we explore how accurately unmeasured contrasts can be synthesized from magnetic resonance fingerprinting (MRF) data. MRF, T1-weighted (T1w), gadolinium-enhanced T1w fat-saturated (Gd T1w fs), and double-echo steady-state (DESS) data were acquired at 3 T from volunteers having knee joint symptoms (n=88). Ten subjects were excluded due to missing MRF-data. U-Nets were trained to synthesize the other contrasts out of the MRF data, and the image quality was evaluated for both the synthetic and conventional by two radiologists. Presence of synovitis was evaluated from Gd T1w fs images. Wilcoxon signed-rank test was utilized to test differences in the image quality scores. Synthetic images overall had only slightly lower image quality in radiologists' evaluation for T1w (3.54 vs 3.88, p<0.01), DESS (3.22 vs 3.90, p<0.01), and Gd T1w fs images (3.40 vs 3.76, p<0.01). Synovitis could not be reliably observed from synthetic Gd T1w fs images. The image quality gap observed earlier persisted in this study and manifested itself steadily across all the joint tissues. Synovitis assessment was not possible from the synthetic contrast-enhanced images.
zh_abstract: [Magma (New York, N.Y.)] 定量MRI一直受到制约，因为它在临床方案之外还增加了扫描时间。在这项横断面研究中，我们探讨了能够从磁共振指纹成像（MRF）数据中以多高准确度合成未测量的对比度。从有膝关节症状的志愿者（n=88）在3 T下采集了MRF、T1加权（T1w）、钆增强T1w脂肪饱和（Gd T1w fs）和双回波稳态（DESS）数据。10名受试者因缺失MRF数据被排除。训练U-Net从MRF数据中合成其他对比度，并由两名放射科医生评估合成图像和常规图像的图像质量。从Gd T1w fs图像评估滑膜炎的存在。使用Wilcoxon符号秩检验检验图像质量评分的差异。总体而言，在放射科医生评估中，合成图像在T1w（3.54 vs 3.88，p<0.01）、DESS（3.22 vs 3.90，p<0.01）和Gd T1w fs图像（3.40 vs 3.76，p<0.01）上的图像质量仅略低。无法从合成Gd T1w fs图像可靠观察滑膜炎。先前观察到的图像质量差距在本研究中持续存在，并在所有关节组织中稳定显现。无法从合成对比增强图像进行滑膜炎评估。

title: Deep Learning-Driven Identification and Experimental Validation of COX-2 and ERK1/2 as Anti-Inflammatory Targets of Avenanthramides.

abstract: [Nutrients] Chronic low-grade inflammation underlies numerous chronic diseases, yet the molecular targets of dietary bioactive compounds remain largely unknown. We developed a deep learning model integrating heterogeneous network propagation, stacked denoising autoencoders, and a CNN classifier to predict inflammation-related targets of food-derived compounds. The model was validated by cross-validation and on eight compounds from distinct structural categories. Avn A, Avn B, and Avn C were then input into the model to predict their anti-inflammatory targets, followed by network analysis, docking, and cellular assays for validation. The model achieved a mean AUC of 0.9587 and an AUPR of 0.9590, with validation on eight structurally diverse compounds confirming its generalizability. For Avn A, Avn B, and Avn C, 118 overlapping anti-inflammatory targets were predicted. Network analysis and KEGG pathway enrichment identified ERK1/2 as a key node within the MAPK and PI3K-AKT signaling pathways, while COX-2 was prioritized for further validation based on its high prediction score. Molecular docking revealed that Avns bound at the cyclooxygenase channel entrance of COX-2 with binding energies of -7.7 to -8.0 kcal/mol, and at the ATP-binding pockets of ERK1/2 with binding energies of -7.0 to -7.7 kcal/mol. In LPS-stimulated macrophages, Avns dose-dependently inhibited COX-2 enzymatic activity and PGE2 production, attenuated ERK1/2 and c-Fos phosphorylation, and suppressed IL-6 and IL-1β expression. Our deep learning model successfully identified COX-2 and ERK1/2 as key mediators of the anti-inflammatory effects of Avns, revealing a dual mechanism involving COX-2 inhibition and ERK/c-Fos pathway blockade. This study provides new evidence for the molecular targets of Avns and demonstrates the utility of deep learning-based approaches for target discovery of dietary bioactive compounds.
zh_abstract: [Nutrients] 慢性低度炎症是许多慢性疾病的基础，但膳食生物活性化合物的分子靶点仍很大程度上未知。我们开发了一个整合异质网络传播、堆叠去噪自编码器和CNN分类器的深度学习模型，用于预测食物来源化合物的炎症相关靶点。该模型通过交叉验证以及在来自不同结构类别的八种化合物上进行验证。随后将Avn A、Avn B和Avn C输入模型以预测其抗炎靶点，随后进行网络分析、对接和细胞实验验证。该模型达到平均AUC 0.9587和AUPR 0.9590，并在八种结构多样的化合物上的验证确认了其泛化能力。对于Avn A、Avn B和Avn C，预测出118个重叠的抗炎靶点。网络分析和KEGG通路富集确定ERK1/2为MAPK和PI3K-AKT信号通路中的关键节点，而COX-2因其高预测评分被优先用于进一步验证。分子对接显示，Avns结合于COX-2的环加氧酶通道入口，结合能为-7.7至-8.0 kcal/mol，并结合于ERK1/2的ATP结合口袋，结合能为-7.0至-7.7 kcal/mol。在LPS刺激的巨噬细胞中，Avns剂量依赖性地抑制COX-2酶活性和PGE2产生，减弱ERK1/2和c-Fos磷酸化，并抑制IL-6和IL-1β表达。我们的深度学习模型成功确定COX-2和ERK1/2为Avns抗炎作用的关键介质，揭示了涉及COX-2抑制和ERK/c-Fos通路阻断的双重机制。本研究为Avns的分子靶点提供了新证据，并证明了基于深度学习的方法在膳食生物活性化合物靶点发现中的实用性。

title: DiaBench: A Benchmarking Framework to Evaluate the Performance of LLMs in T2D Patient Education
zh_title: DiaBench：评估大模型2型糖尿病患者教育能力的基准
summary: medRxiv预印本发布DiaBench，用96组临床医患问答构建选择题基准评估大模型患者教育表现。
key_points: 基于临床医生采集的96组真实问答对构建
设三种题目配置模拟不同健康素养水平
由糖尿病教育专家与内分泌医生组成小组校验
reason: 预印本小型基准且有专家校验，但规模有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Background Effective type 2 diabetes (T2D) education improves patient outcomes, but clinician time constraints limit what can be covered during encounters. Large language models (LLMs) offer a scalable way to answer patient questions, yet their accuracy and reliability in T2D education across health literacy levels remain poorly characterized. Methods We developed DiaBench, a standardized benchmarking framework built from 96 question-and-answer pairs collected by clinicians from representative real-world patient encounters. GPT-5 transformed each pair into multiple-choice questions (MCQs) under three configurations (1-3) simulating different question formats and levels of user background. A five-member panel of certified diabetes care and education specialists (CDCESs), medical doctors (MDs), and endocrinologists validated the transformations, rating question rephrasing, answer rephrasing, and answer correctness. We then evaluated seven LLMs (GPT-51, Gemini-2.5-Flash2, Cohere Command3, Llama-44, DeepSeek-R15, Perplexity Sonar6, Mistral-Large-2.07) for accuracy and self-consistency across three runs. Results (i) Expert validation showed a consensus over MCQ transformation. For configuration 1, 98.1% (SD 0.01) of rephrased answers were appropriate, 98.1% (SD 0.01) of MCQ answers were correct, and 95.0% (SD 0.05) of rephrased questions were appropriate; corresponding values for configuration 2 were 96.3% (SD 0.05), 97.5% (SD 0.02), and 89.8% (SD 0.14). (ii) across benchmarking for configurations 1 and 2, most models achieved high accuracy ([≥]95%), but Mistral-Large-2.0, Llama 4, and Perplexity Sonar showed substantially lower self-consistency (60.4%-91.7%) than other models ([≥]95%). All models degraded in both accuracy and self-consistency on configuration 3. Conclusions DiaBench quantitatively differentiates LLM capability in T2D patient education, with Gemini, GPT-5, and DeepSeek-R1 performing strongly and other models suboptimally. DiaBench provides a transferable platform for evaluating existing and newly developed LLMs, addressing the need for standardized benchmarking before clinical deployment of LLM-based systems in patient education.
zh_abstract: 【背景】有效的 2 型糖尿病（type 2 diabetes, T2D）教育可改善患者结局，但临床医生时间限制限制了在就诊期间可涵盖的内容。大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）为回答患者问题提供了可扩展的方式，但其在不同健康素养水平的 T2D 教育中的准确性和可靠性仍缺乏充分表征。【方法】我们开发了 DiaBench，这是一个标准化基准测试框架，基于临床医生从具有代表性的真实患者就诊中收集的 96 个问答对构建。GPT-5 将每个问答对转换为多项选择题（multiple-choice questions, MCQs），采用三种配置（1-3）模拟不同的问题格式和用户背景水平。由认证糖尿病护理与教育专家（certified diabetes care and education specialists, CDCESs）、医生（medical doctors, MDs）和内分泌科医生组成的五人小组验证了这些转换，并对问题改写、答案改写和答案正确性进行评分。随后，我们评估了七种 LLMs（GPT-51、Gemini-2.5-Flash2、Cohere Command3、Llama-44、DeepSeek-R15、Perplexity Sonar6、Mistral-Large-2.07）在三次运行中的准确性和自洽性。【结果】（i）专家验证显示对 MCQ 转换达成共识。对于配置 1，98.1%（SD 0.01）的改写答案适当，98.1%（SD 0.01）的 MCQ 答案正确，95.0%（SD 0.05）的改写问题适当；配置 2 的对应值分别为 96.3%（SD 0.05）、97.5%（SD 0.02）和 89.8%（SD 0.14）。（ii）在配置 1 和配置 2 的基准测试中，大多数模型达到高准确率（[≥]95%），但 Mistral-Large-2.0、Llama 4 和 Perplexity Sonar 的自洽性（60.4%-91.7%）显著低于其他模型（[≥]95%）。所有模型在配置 3 上的准确率和自洽性均下降。【结论】DiaBench 定量区分了 LLMs 在 T2D 患者教育中的能力，其中 Gemini、GPT-5 和 DeepSeek-R1 表现强劲，其他模型表现欠佳。DiaBench 为评估现有和新开发的 LLMs 提供了可迁移平台，满足了在患者教育中临床部署基于 LLM 的系统之前进行标准化基准测试的需求。

title: A 211K Parameter Foundation Model: Genetic Prompting in Neural Cellular Automata
zh_title: 21.1万参数医学分割基础模型：神经细胞自动机中的遗传提示
summary: 预印本提出轻量基础模型Foundational-NCA，经遗传提示机制无需重训即可适配多种医学分割任务。
key_points: 基于神经细胞自动机，参数量仅211K
以紧凑任务向量+遗传提示实现跨任务动态适配
面向算力有限场景，未报告外部验证
reason: 预印本新方法有明确思路，但尚未见外部验证与公开评测，属值得一看档
abstract: The scale of modern foundation models enables broad task generalization. In medical imaging, where segmentation demands vary widely across clinical contexts, such flexibility is invaluable. But current models, such as SAM trade adaptability for scale, locking their utility behind high-end infrastructure and leaving behind the low-resource environments most in need of diagnostic support. To bridge this gap, we introduce Foundational-NCA, a lightweight foundation model capable of adapting to a wide range of medical segmentation tasks without retraining. Built on Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), Foundational-NCA incorporates gradient-based learning with genetic optimization over a latent task space, using a compact task vector to guide predictions. This enables dynamic adaptation via a genetic prompt mechanism, allowing the model to generalize across tasks while keeping the parameter count magnitudes lower at just 211 thousand, compared to SAM-based models with 38.9 to 636 million parameters. We evaluate Foundational-NCA on 15 trained and 6 entirely unseen segmentation tasks from the TotalSegmentator dataset, achieving an average Dice score of 84.5% on known tasks and 60.4% on unseen ones. These results demonstrate that task generalization is possible in ultra-compact models, laying the groundwork for resource-efficient, deployable foundation models in clinical environments where infrastructure is limited. By reducing model size by over 180 times, Foundational-NCA takes a step toward a more equitable future for medical AI, one where powerful tools are within reach of every healthcare setting.
zh_abstract: 现代基础模型的规模使广泛的任务泛化成为可能。在医学影像中，分割需求在不同临床情境中差异很大，这种灵活性极其宝贵。但当前模型（如 SAM）为规模牺牲了适应性，将其效用锁在高端基础设施之后，使最需要诊断支持的低资源环境被落下。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 Foundational-NCA，一种无需重新训练即可适应广泛医学分割任务的轻量级基础模型。Foundational-NCA 构建于神经细胞自动机（Neural Cellular Automata, NCA）之上，在潜在任务空间上将基于梯度的学习与遗传优化相结合，使用紧凑的任务向量来指导预测。这通过遗传提示机制实现动态适应，使模型能够跨任务泛化，同时将参数量保持在低若干个数量级的水平，仅为 211 千，而基于 SAM 的模型具有 38.9 百万至 636 百万参数。我们在来自 TotalSegmentator 数据集的 15 个已训练分割任务和 6 个完全未见过的分割任务上评估 Foundational-NCA，在已知任务上平均 Dice 分数为 84.5%，在未见任务上为 60.4%。这些结果表明，超紧凑模型也能实现任务泛化，为基础设施有限的临床环境中资源高效、可部署的基础模型奠定基础。通过将模型规模缩小超过 180 倍，Foundational-NCA 朝着医疗 AI 更公平的未来迈出一步，使强大工具能够触及每一种医疗环境。

title: Interpreting Graph Neural Networks for Antibacterial Drug Repurposing against Acinetobacter baumannii
zh_title: 图神经网络解释助力抗击鲍曼不动杆菌的药物重定位
summary: bioRxiv预印本用图神经网络集成筛选抗菌化合物，并以原子级解释定位关键分子特征。
key_points: 仅用原子特征与连接关系，性能与描述符基线相当
原子级解释在扰动与恢复条件下识别活性相关特征
指出哌嗪为最一致的预测相关子结构
reason: 预印本计算方法含可解释性分析，但无湿实验验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Antimicrobial resistance in Acinetobacter baumannii, whose carbapenem-resistant strains are classified by the World Health Organization as a critical priority, has motivated machine-learning screens for new antibacterials, but translating predictions into chemical hypotheses requires evaluating the molecular features on which a model relies. A graph neural network ensemble achieves competitive predictive performance against a descriptor-augmented reference model on the same antibacterial screen while using only atom features and connectivity, allowing interpretation to focus on the molecular graph without a separate input of handcrafted descriptors. The atom-level explanations identify features supporting the model's activity predictions under perturbation and restoration, while comparisons with equally sized perturbations within each molecule distinguish piperazine as the most consistently supported recurring contributor to predicted activity. Prospective screening of the Drug Repurposing Hub followed by developability and safety assessment yields a ranked shortlist for experimental follow-up and leads to testing of CE3F4, which reduced A. baumannii growth by 57% at 0.25 mM in a preliminary assay with a non-monotonic concentration--response profile.
zh_abstract: 鲍曼不动杆菌（Acinetobacter baumannii）的抗菌药物耐药性——其耐碳青霉烯类菌株被世界卫生组织（World Health Organization）列为关键优先事项——促使人们采用机器学习筛选新型抗菌药物，但要将预测转化为化学假设，需要评估模型所依赖的分子特征。一个图神经网络集成（graph neural network ensemble）在同一抗菌筛选任务上，仅使用原子特征和连接性，就取得了与描述符增强的参考模型（descriptor-augmented reference model）具有竞争力的预测性能，从而使解释能够聚焦于分子图，而无需单独输入手工设计的描述符。原子级解释识别出在扰动和恢复条件下支持模型活性预测的特征，同时与每个分子内同等大小的扰动进行比较，可将哌嗪（piperazine）区分为对预测活性支持最一致的反复出现的贡献因素。对药物再利用中心（Drug Repurposing Hub）进行前瞻性筛选，随后进行可开发性和安全性评估，产生了一份用于实验后续研究的排序候选清单，并导致对 CE3F4 的测试；在一项初步试验中，CE3F4 在 0.25 mM 下使鲍曼不动杆菌生长减少 57%，且呈现非单调的浓度-反应特征。

title: Using iterative agentic retrieval-augmented generation to refine the risk of infection from social contexts during the COVID-19 pandemic: Development and Evaluation Study
zh_title: 用迭代式智能体检索增强生成细化社交场景的感染风险
summary: 基于比利时学生社区19434条社交描述训练LSTM，并嵌入Llama3构建对话式检索增强智能体来预测新冠感染风险。
key_points: 用19434条文本社交互动描述训练LSTM风险模型
将模型接入Llama3，构建可多轮追问的检索增强会话框架
目的是按个人化社交细节迭代修正感染风险估计
reason: 有新意的智能体框架预印本，单一社区队列、无外部验证
abstract: Background: Contact tracing is crucial to limit pathogen transmission and to gather epidemiological data. However, despite machine learning optimizations, it remains time-consuming. Large language models have been used for infection risk prediction, but no existing application converses with a user to adapt its risk estimates. Objective: We aimed to develop an iterative retrieval-augmented generation conversational framework to predict coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) infection risk from textual social data. The conversational agent aims to gather personalized risk factors based on descriptions of social interactions. Methods: We trained a long short-term memory (LSTM) model to predict the risk of COVID-19 infection from 19,434 textual descriptions of social interactions, collected during the pandemic in the Leuven student community, in Belgium. We integrated this model into a Llama3.3-based conversational framework that iteratively gathers additional social information that may represent a risk of infection. We evaluated the framework using large language model (LLM)-as-a-judge metrics and by comparing its risk assessment in different social contexts. Results: Based solely on social interaction data, a fine-tuned RobBERT model predicted infection risk with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC AUC) of 0.73. It performed similarly to an LSTM model and a logistic regression on term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF) features, which both achieved a ROC AUC of 0.72. These three models slightly outperformed a Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA)-fine-tuned Mistral NeMo model (ROC AUC = 0.69). Llama3.3 performed well in our framework: the predicted infection risk converged often, and it asked fewer redundant questions than the smaller models (Mistral 7B, Gemma3 12B). In addition, the framework showed the ability to stratify, by risk of infection, synthetic users who had different types of social interactions. Conclusions: Combining simple language models with large language models can refine individual infection risk from contact tracing data in a high-circulation context. Our conversational framework may help optimize contact tracing by highlighting social contexts with a high risk of infection.
zh_abstract: 【背景】接触者追踪对于限制病原体传播和收集流行病学数据至关重要。然而，尽管有机器学习优化，它仍然耗时。大型语言模型已被用于感染风险预测，但尚无现有应用能与用户对话以调整其风险估计。【目的】我们旨在开发一个迭代式检索增强生成对话框架，以根据文本社交数据预测2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）感染风险。该对话代理旨在基于社交互动描述收集个性化风险因素。【方法】我们训练了一个长短期记忆（LSTM）模型，从比利时鲁汶学生社区在大流行期间收集的19,434条社交互动文本描述中预测COVID-19感染风险。我们将该模型集成到一个基于Llama3.3的对话框架中，该框架迭代收集可能代表感染风险的额外社交信息。我们使用大型语言模型（LLM）作为评判者的指标，并通过比较其在不同社交情境中的风险评估来评估该框架。【结果】仅基于社交互动数据，一个微调的RobBERT模型预测感染风险，受试者工作特征曲线下面积（ROC AUC）为0.73。它的表现与LSTM模型以及在词频-逆文档频率（TF-IDF）特征上的逻辑回归相似，后两者均达到ROC AUC 0.72。这三个模型略微优于经量化低秩适配（QLoRA）微调的Mistral NeMo模型（ROC AUC = 0.69）。Llama3.3在我们的框架中表现良好：预测的感染风险经常收敛，并且它比更小的模型（Mistral 7B、Gemma3 12B）提出更少的冗余问题。此外，该框架显示出能够按感染风险对具有不同类型社交互动的合成用户进行分层。【结论】将简单语言模型与大型语言模型相结合，可以在高传播情境中根据接触者追踪数据细化个体感染风险。我们的对话框架可能通过突出高感染风险的社交情境来帮助优化接触者追踪。

title: An Agentic AI Pipeline for an Evidence-Grounded Environmental Health Public Information System: Development and Evaluation
zh_title: 证据锚定的环境健康公共信息智能体系统
summary: 研究开发并评估一个智能体AI流程，为公众环境健康问题提供基于证据的社区尺度回答。
key_points: 面向盐湖谷等复杂环境城市的居民与医疗提供者
动态整合权威天气、空气质量等数据
目标是提供及时、本地化、可行动信息
reason: 预印本智能体公共卫生系统，方法有新意但摘要未给评估结果，属中等
abstract: Background: Existing environmental and health information systems typically provide isolated data streams, requiring users to interpret heterogeneous information sources without personalized guidance. Residents and health providers of urban regions with complex environmental conditions, such as the Salt Lake Valley, frequently seek timely, location-specific information about weather, air quality, and their associated health impacts, but may find it difficult to integrate this information in their decision-making, precluding the effective translation of valuable environmental health information into action. Objective: This study aimed to develop and evaluate an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) pipeline that delivers evidence-grounded, neighborhood-scale responses to health-related environmental questions raised lay persons by dynamically orchestrating authoritative weather, neighborhood-scale environmental observations, air quality, and health-evidence resources. Methods: We developed an agentic AI pipeline using LangGraph and OpenAI large language models to interpret natural language queries, select and invoke relevant external tools, retrieve real-time environmental data and evidence-based health guidance, and synthesize responses. The pipeline integrates multiple authoritative resources, including weather forecasts, air-quality observations, geospatial services, and a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) module built from asthma-related clinical guidance. The system incorporates fallback mechanisms to improve robustness when external services are unavailable. We evaluated the pipeline using a curated benchmark of representative user questions, assessing tool-needed recognition, correct tool selection, avoidance of irrelevant tools, parameter mapping, analytic pathway selection, and incorporation of tool outputs into the final response. Results: The developed system successfully integrated heterogeneous environmental and health information sources into a unified conversational interface that produces evidence-grounded, neighborhood-scale responses for the Salt Lake Valley. Evaluation demonstrated generally strong tool recognition, parameter mapping, and incorporation of retrieved information across diverse question types, supporting the pipeline's ability to retrieve and integrate authoritative environmental and health information consumable by lay persons and providing an important step for the T3 and T4 phases of the translational pipeline of exposu
zh_abstract: 【背景】现有环境和健康信息系统通常提供孤立的数据流，要求用户在没有个性化指导的情况下解读异质性信息来源。在环境条件复杂的城市地区（如盐湖谷），居民和医疗服务提供者经常寻求有关天气、空气质量及其相关健康影响的及时、特定地点信息，但可能难以将这些信息整合到决策中，从而阻碍了有价值的环境健康信息有效转化为行动。【目的】本研究旨在开发和评估一种智能体人工智能（AI）流水线，通过动态编排权威天气、社区尺度环境观测、空气质量和健康证据资源，为普通人提出的健康相关环境问题提供有证据依据的、社区尺度的回答。【方法】我们使用LangGraph和OpenAI大语言模型开发了一种智能体AI流水线，用于解释自然语言查询、选择并调用相关外部工具、检索实时环境数据和循证健康指导，并综合生成回答。该流水线整合了多种权威资源，包括天气预报、空气质量观测、地理空间服务，以及基于哮喘相关临床指导构建的检索增强生成（RAG）模块。系统包含回退机制，以在外部服务不可用时提高稳健性。我们使用由代表性用户问题构建的精选基准评估该流水线，评估内容包括识别是否需要工具、正确选择工具、避免使用无关工具、参数映射、分析路径选择，以及将工具输出纳入最终回答。【结果】所开发的系统成功将异质性环境和健康信息来源整合到统一的对话界面中，为盐湖谷生成有证据依据的、社区尺度的回答。评估显示，在不同问题类型中，工具识别、参数映射和检索信息纳入总体较强，支持该流水线检索和整合普通人可理解的权威环境与健康信息的能力，并为暴露……转化流水线的T3和T4阶段提供了重要一步。

title: Coach-BP: Computer Vision-Based Assessment and Correction of Blood Pressure Measurement Technique
zh_title: Coach-BP：计算机视觉评估血压测量手法
summary: 预印本开发视频计算机视觉系统，检测血压测量姿势等五种手法错误并实时指导。
key_points: 225名参与者共408次测量，前后摄像头拍摄
对照临床专家评分，采用留一参与者交叉验证
检测五项AHA测量标准并考察模拟扰动鲁棒性
