abstract: Background: Accurate blood pressure (BP) measurement, essential for hypertension care, requires proper technique. Posture errors can raise systolic BP by more than 20 mm Hg, yet technique is rarely verified objectively. We aimed to develop and evaluate Coach-BP, a computer vision system that detects technique errors from video to support real-time coaching. Methods: We enrolled adults attending an academic cardiovascular prevention center between February and April 2026 and filmed BP measurements with front and side cameras. We analyzed 408 encounters from 225 participants. Coach-BP uses machine learning models trained on clinician labels to assess five American Heart Association criteria using pose, visual context, and audio-visual features. We evaluated its accuracy against expert clinician ratings by leave-one-participant-out cross-validation. We then examined robustness to simulated camera artifacts and interpreted the features important for each criterion. Findings: At baseline, 138 (62%) of 223 participants had at least one technique error and 54 (24%) two or more. Coach-BP achieved a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.93 (95% CI 0.90-0.94), with 0.97 (0.94-0.99) for legs uncrossed, 0.97 (0.93-1.00) for no talking, 0.92 (0.85-0.98) for back supported, 0.91 (0.86-0.95) for feet flat, and 0.86 (0.81-0.91) for arm supported at heart level. Mean balanced accuracy was 0.88 (0.85-0.90). Performance was robust to simulated camera shift, zoom, and rotation. Its models relied on features clinicians would assess, such as cuffed-hand height and foot position. One model classified back support similarly from either camera. Interpretation: Coach-BP accurately detected errors in the five guideline-recommended criteria of BP measurement technique from clinic video, enabling objective assessment of each criterion.
zh_abstract: 【背景】准确的血压（BP）测量对高血压管理至关重要，需要规范的操作技术。姿势错误可使收缩压升高超过20 mm Hg，但操作技术很少被客观核验。我们旨在开发并评估Coach-BP，这是一种计算机视觉系统，可从视频中检测操作技术错误，以支持实时指导。【方法】我们纳入2026年2月至4月期间就诊于一家学术性心血管预防中心的成年人，并用前置和侧置摄像头拍摄血压测量过程。我们分析了来自225名参与者的408次测量。Coach-BP使用基于临床医生标注训练的机器学习模型，利用姿态、视觉情境和视听特征评估美国心脏协会的五项标准。我们通过留一参与者交叉验证，将Coach-BP的准确性对照专家临床医生评分进行评估。随后，我们检查了其对模拟摄像头伪影的稳健性，并解释了各项标准的重要特征。【结果】在基线时，223名参与者中有138名（62%）存在至少一项操作技术错误，54名（24%）存在两项或更多错误。Coach-BP的平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.93（95% CI 0.90-0.94），其中双腿未交叉为0.97（0.94-0.99），不说话为0.97（0.93-1.00），背部有支撑为0.92（0.85-0.98），双脚平放为0.91（0.86-0.95），手臂在心脏水平有支撑为0.86（0.81-0.91）。平均平衡准确率为0.88（0.85-0.90）。其性能对模拟的摄像头平移、缩放和旋转具有稳健性。其模型依赖于临床医生会评估的特征，例如缚袖带手的高度和脚的位置。一个模型从任一摄像头对背部支撑的分类相似。【解释】Coach-BP能够从临床视频中准确检测血压测量技术五项指南推荐标准中的错误，从而实现对每项标准的客观评估。

title: Learning Scientific Trajectories to Predict Future Biomedical Discoveries
zh_title: 学习科学轨迹预测生物医学发现
summary: 预印本提出ForeSCITE框架，利用已发表结论的语义时间结构生成自然语言假设。
key_points: 从约300万条结论构建407个主题簇
估计簇内时间方向并投影结论嵌入
解码投影坐标生成假设，回顾性时间切片评估提升语义表现
reason: 方法新颖、规模大，但为预印本且评估为回顾性，属值得一看档
abstract: AI co-scientists have expanded the use of large language models for generating scientific hypotheses and guiding experimental investigation. Here we investigate whether temporal patterns in the semantic representations of complete biomedical conclusions can guide hypothesis generation. We introduce ForeSCITE, a framework that identifies thematic clusters of published conclusions, estimates a direction separating earlier from more recent findings within each cluster, and projects existing conclusion embeddings along these directions. An embedding language model trained to reconstruct conclusions decodes the projected coordinates into natural-language hypotheses. Across 407 clusters derived from approximately three million pre-cutoff conclusions, we identify temporal structure and illustrate its retention after decoding. In retrospective, time-sliced evaluations, ForeSCITE increases semantic coverage beyond the historical corpus, biomedical entity-pair novelty and post-cutoff pair re-observation relative to five prompt-based and retrieval-augmented baselines. Expert review of prioritized CAR-T hypotheses identified 37 candidates as both novel and biologically plausible, and expert justifications for five selected hypotheses illustrate their biological rationale and subsequent literature support where available. These findings support temporal guidance in semantic space as a scalable mechanism for proposing biomedical hypotheses for subsequent scientific evaluation.
zh_abstract: AI共同科学家已扩展了大语言模型在生成科学假设和指导实验研究方面的应用。在此，我们研究完整生物医学结论的语义表示中的时间模式是否可以指导假设生成。我们引入ForeSCITE，这是一个框架，用于识别已发表结论的主题簇，估计每个簇内区分较早发现与较新发现的方向，并沿这些方向投影现有结论嵌入。一个经过训练以重建结论的嵌入语言模型将投影坐标解码为自然语言假设。在由约三百万条截止时间前结论衍生的407个簇中，我们识别出时间结构并说明其在解码后的保留。在两个回顾性、按时间切片的评估中，ForeSCITE相对于五个基于提示和检索增强的基线，提高了超出历史语料的语义覆盖、生物医学实体对新颖性以及截止时间后实体对的再次观察。对优先排序的CAR-T假设进行专家评审，识别出37个候选既新颖又具有生物学合理性；对五个选定假设的专家论证说明了其生物学依据以及在可获得情况下的后续文献支持。这些发现支持语义空间中的时间引导作为提出生物医学假设以供后续科学评估的可扩展机制。

title: Latent Decision Flow Rewards for Clinical Guideline Reasoning
zh_title: 面向临床指南推理的潜决策流奖励
summary: 预印本提出利用临床指南的条件决策流做过程监督，针对路径-答案不一致与路径多样性问题改进推理模型训练。
key_points: 指出路径-答案差距与路径多重性问题
现有答案奖励与流程奖励各管一部分
标注流程微调可能限制轨迹并降低准确率
reason: 有新方法思路的预印本，尚无外部验证与临床结局数据
abstract: Clinical practice guidelines encode evidence-based recommendations as conditional decision flows, which makes them a natural source of process supervision for training reasoning models. Two properties of clinical reasoning make this supervision difficult to use. A decision flow consistent with a guideline does not by itself determine the correct answer for a given patient, which we call the path--answer gap, and several valid decision flows can support the same clinical decision, which we call path multiplicity. Current training approaches address parts of this problem. Answer rewards supervise the final decision, and process rewards computed against a reference flow supervise one valid decision flow per case. Supervised fine-tuning on annotated flows teaches guideline-consistent reasoning but constrains the model to one trajectory per case and can reduce answer accuracy. We introduce GUIDER, a method that jointly optimizes a decision flow controller and a reasoning policy. The controller learns to generate plausible decision flows from guideline-derived supervision, and the policy learns to generate a decision flow and a final answer for each patient case. GUIDER computes the process reward for the policy over several controller-generated flows, which accounts for path multiplicity, and gates this reward on answer correctness, which addresses the path--answer gap. Joint training allows the process supervision to evolve with the policy. On MedGUIDE, GUIDER with Qwen3-14B achieves 82.5 weighted accuracy and 73.5 guideline adherence, 3.3 and 3.1 points above the strongest clinical reinforcement learning baseline. With Qwen3-14B and Gemma4-12B backbones, GUIDER also improves over CRPO, MRPO, and FaithMed on the out-of-domain benchmarks AMEGA-LLM, RealMedQA, and CancerGUIDE.
zh_abstract: 临床实践指南将循证推荐编码为条件决策流，这使其成为训练推理模型时过程监督的自然来源。临床推理的两个特性使这种监督难以使用。与指南一致的决策流本身并不能确定给定患者的正确答案，我们称之为路径—答案差距；多个有效决策流可以支持同一临床决策，我们称之为路径多重性。当前训练方法解决了该问题的部分内容。答案奖励监督最终决策，而针对参考流计算的过程奖励监督每个病例的一个有效决策流。对标注流进行监督微调可教会与指南一致的推理，但将模型限制为每个病例一条轨迹，并可能降低答案准确性。我们引入GUIDER，一种联合优化决策流控制器和推理策略的方法。控制器学习从指南衍生的监督中生成合理的决策流，策略学习为每个患者病例生成决策流和最终答案。GUIDER在多个控制器生成的流上为策略计算过程奖励，这考虑了路径多重性，并以答案正确性对该奖励进行门控，从而解决路径—答案差距。联合训练使过程监督能够随策略演化。在MedGUIDE上，使用Qwen3-14B的GUIDER达到82.5的加权准确率和73.5的指南依从性，分别比最强的临床强化学习基线高3.3分和3.1分。在Qwen3-14B和Gemma4-12B骨干模型下，GUIDER在域外基准AMEGA-LLM、RealMedQA和CancerGUIDE上也优于CRPO、MRPO和FaithMed。

title: Fu-TCM: a multimodal large language model that learns traditional Chinese medicine diagnostic reasoning
zh_title: Fu-TCM：学习中医辨证推理的多模态大模型
summary: arXiv预印本发布Fu-TCM，用约712万条中医数据训练并以BGPO优化辨证推理。
key_points: 训练数据约712万条，涵盖典籍、教材、图像与临床病例
提出Bianzheng-Grounded Policy Optimization强化辨证推理
Fu-TCM-27B在六个中医基准上领先
reason: 预印本新模型有一定规模与基准对比，但未经外部临床验证
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are advancing in multimodal understanding and reasoning, accelerating medical model development. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) uses evidence from the four examinations to determine disease location and nature, differentiate syndromes and guide treatment. This diagnostic process constitutes a complete chain of reasoning. We present Fu-TCM, a multimodal TCM LLM trained on data retained after cleaning and filtering an initial collection of approximately 7.12 million examples derived from classical texts, textbooks, medical images, clinical cases and publicly available datasets. The model was further optimized using Bianzheng-Grounded Policy Optimization (BGPO), which explicitly targets syndrome differentiation through rewards for response format, intermediate TCM reasoning fields and final syndrome predictions. Fu-TCM-27B led all six benchmarks spanning TCM reasoning, text and vision, achieving a macro-average accuracy of 81.01% and surpassing the strongest reference model with complete results across all six benchmarks by 7.13 percentage points. Its largest margin was 11.90 points on Fu-bianzheng. Case-level analyses further showed a positive association between intermediate-field accuracy and final syndrome-selection accuracy in most evaluated models. These findings suggest that TCM syndrome differentiation may be computationally learnable and that structured reasoning supervision can improve performance across TCM tasks.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在多模态理解与推理方面不断进步，加速了医学模型的发展。中医（TCM）利用四诊证据确定病位与病性、辨证并指导治疗。这一诊断过程构成完整的推理链。我们提出 Fu-TCM，一种多模态中医大语言模型，其训练数据来自对初始约 712 万条样本（源自经典文本、教材、医学图像、临床病例和公开数据集）进行清洗和过滤后保留的数据。该模型进一步采用辨证锚定策略优化（Bianzheng-Grounded Policy Optimization, BGPO）进行优化，该方法通过对回答格式、中医中间推理字段和最终证候预测给予奖励，明确以辨证为目标。Fu-TCM-27B 在涵盖中医推理、文本和视觉的全部六项基准测试中领先，达到 81.01% 的宏平均准确率，并比在全部六项基准测试中均有完整结果的最强参考模型高出 7.13 个百分点。其最大领先幅度为 Fu-bianzheng 上的 11.90 分。病例层面分析进一步显示，在大多数被评估模型中，中间字段准确率与最终证候选择准确率之间存在正相关。这些发现提示，中医辨证可能是可计算学习的，并且结构化推理监督可以提升各类中医任务的性能。

title: Deep learning for non-transvenous ICD screening: tailored neural network architectures, extended experiments, and explainability
zh_title: 非经静脉ICD筛查的深度学习：定制网络架构与可解释性
summary: 提出覆盖24小时动态心电的皮下与血管外ICD筛查框架AmpRatioNet，首次在EV-ICD队列做T:R分析并完整评估P:R预测。
key_points: 针对S-ICD与EV-ICD过度感知导致的不恰当放电风险
直接作用于心电信号的1D卷积网络AmpRatioNet
含可解释性分析，突破单次10秒心电筛查局限
reason: 方法有新意，属预印本，未见外部验证或前瞻性设计
abstract: This paper studies two non-transvenous implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs), namely the Subcutaneous ICD (S-ICD) and the Extravascular ICD (EV-ICD). Both avoid the complications of transvenous leads but are prone to oversensing, which can trigger inappropriate shocks associated with increased mortality. Oversensing risk is predicted by the ratio of T- or P-wave amplitude to R-wave amplitude (T:R, P:R), and these ratios vary over a 24-hour period. Yet S-ICD screening uses a single 10-second electrocardiogram (ECG) segment, and the EV-ICD has no formal screening protocol whatsoever. We present a 24-hour ambulatory screening framework for both devices which includes the first T:R analysis in an EV-ICD cohort and the first full evaluation of P:R prediction. We introduce AmpRatioNet, a family of 1D convolutional neural network architectures operating directly on the ECG signal, and benchmark it against the best existing approach - based on 2D phase space reconstruction images. Evaluation uses 4,605 clinician-annotated 10-second segments from 89 patients, with patient-level 10-fold cross-validation and bootstrap confidence intervals. AmpRatioNet-SE demonstrates superior performance on every metric in each setting with no device- or ratio-specific redesign. An explainability analysis against interpretable classical peak labelling algorithms shows that AmpRatioNet-SE's increase in error on oversensing-prone segments is up to 14 times smaller than theirs. Segment-level predictions are aggregated into a 24-hour timeline, extending S-ICD screening beyond 10 seconds and offering a plausible EV-ICD screening pathway pending device-level validation.
zh_abstract: 本文研究两种非经静脉植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD），即皮下ICD（S-ICD）和血管外ICD（EV-ICD）。两者均避免了经静脉导线的并发症，但易发生过感知，这可能触发不恰当电击，并与死亡率增加相关。过感知风险由T波或P波振幅与R波振幅之比（T:R、P:R）预测，而这些比值在24小时期间会变化。然而，S-ICD筛查使用单个10秒心电图（ECG）片段，而EV-ICD则完全没有正式筛查方案。我们提出一个适用于两种设备的24小时动态筛查框架，其中包括首个在EV-ICD队列中进行的T:R分析，以及首个对P:R预测的全面评估。我们介绍AmpRatioNet，这是一族直接作用于ECG信号的一维卷积神经网络架构，并将其与现有最佳方法——基于二维相空间重建图像的方法——进行基准比较。评估使用来自89例患者的4,605个由临床医生标注的10秒片段，采用患者水平10折交叉验证和bootstrap置信区间。AmpRatioNet-SE在每个设置中的每项指标上均表现出优越性能，且未针对设备或比值进行特定重新设计。与可解释的经典峰值标注算法进行的可解释性分析显示，AmpRatioNet-SE在易发生过感知片段上的误差增加幅度最多比它们小14倍。片段级预测被汇总到24小时时间线中，将S-ICD筛查扩展到10秒之外，并提供了一个可行的EV-ICD筛查路径，尚待设备级验证。

title: Vision Tomography: Towards Portable 3D Bidirectional Face-Skull Inference from Visual Data
zh_title: Vision Tomography：从视觉数据推断三维面部—颅骨
summary: 研究提出Vision Tomography框架，从视觉数据重建配对三维面部与颅骨几何，并构建200余例数据集。
key_points: 数据集含CT颅骨、CT面部与高保真纹理面部扫描
提出密集射线匹配配准方法保证拓扑一致性
目标为便携、无辐射的颅骨三维获取
reason: 预印本新方法，数据集仅200余例、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Traditional computed tomography (CT) can capture paired 3D face and skull geometry, but it remains costly, fixed in location, and exposes patients to radiation. For applications such as remote diagnostics, digital healthcare, forensic identification, missing-person investigation, and archaeological analysis, there is an urgent need for a portable, safe, and accessible solution to capture 3D skull geometry. In this work, we introduce Vision Tomography (VT), a concept and framework capable of reconstructing paired 3D face-skull geometry from various visual modalities, and also enabling joint manipulation of 3D facial and skull geometry. To achieve this, we first construct a dataset of over 200 samples, where each case includes a CT-based skull, a CT-based face, and a high-fidelity textured face scan. Secondly, we propose a novel dense ray matching registration method that ensures topological consistency across face, skull, and their tissue correspondences. Building on this registration, we introduce the 3D Bidirectional Face-Skull Morphable Model (BFSM) as the foundation of Vision Tomography, which enables shape inference between the face and skull through a shared coefficient space, while also modeling tissue thickness variation to support one-to-many facial reconstructions from the same skull, reflecting individual facial changes such as age or body fat. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of Vision Tomography across various forensic and medical applications, including paired 3D face-skull reconstruction from images or sketches and predicting surgical outcomes with joint face-skull editing. Extensive experiments confirm the robustness and accuracy of our method. Vision Tomography is available at https://github.com/wang-zidu/BFSM
zh_abstract: 传统计算机断层扫描（CT）可捕获配对的3D面部和颅骨几何结构，但其仍然成本高、位置固定，并使患者暴露于辐射。对于远程诊断、数字医疗、法医鉴定、失踪人员调查和考古分析等应用，迫切需要一种便携、安全且易于使用的解决方案来捕获3D颅骨几何结构。在本工作中，我们提出Vision Tomography（VT），这是一种概念和框架，能够从多种视觉模态重建配对的3D面部-颅骨几何结构，并且还能实现3D面部和颅骨几何结构的联合操作。为实现这一目标，我们首先构建了一个包含200多个样本的数据集，其中每个病例包括基于CT的颅骨、基于CT的面部以及高保真带纹理面部扫描。其次，我们提出一种新颖的稠密射线匹配配准方法，确保面部、颅骨及其组织对应关系之间的拓扑一致性。在此配准基础上，我们引入3D双向面部-颅骨可变形模型（BFSM）作为Vision Tomography的基础，该模型通过共享系数空间实现面部与颅骨之间的形状推断，同时建模组织厚度变化，以支持从同一颅骨进行一对多的面部重建，反映年龄或体脂等个体面部变化。最后，我们展示了Vision Tomography在各种法医和医学应用中的有效性，包括从图像或素描重建配对的3D面部-颅骨，以及通过联合面部-颅骨编辑预测手术结局。大量实验证实了我们方法的稳健性和准确性。Vision Tomography可在 https://github.com/wang-zidu/BFSM 获取

title: Knowledge-structured and evidence-aware semantic self-distillation for glomerular pathology foundation model
zh_title: 肾小球病理基础模型的语义自蒸馏框架
summary: GloSAGE用预训练视觉教师生成结构化病理描述，通过语义自蒸馏训练肾小球病理基础模型。
key_points: 以视觉教师预测的病变谱合成病理文本
图像-文本对齐训练投影层，视觉编码器冻结

abstract: Visual foundation models learn rich pathological morphology but lack explicit concept-level supervision. Vision--language pretraining can provide this supervision but requires costly image--text pairs. Here, we introduce GloSAGE, a semantic self-distillation framework that uses lesion profiles predicted by a pretrained visual teacher to construct structured pathology descriptions. Reliability-guided selection identifies image--text anchors, while Knowledge-Structured Pathology Text Synthesis and Evidence-Guided Negative-pair Construction account for partially observed lesions. Image--text alignment trains projection layers while retaining the frozen visual encoder; an intermediate Semantic Transfer Layer supplies features for downstream tasks. Developed on GloMillion and evaluated across seven glomerulus- and case-level cohorts, GloSAGE supported zero-shot lesion recognition, image--text retrieval, hard-negative discrimination and concept-intervention analyses. It outperformed its source visual model in most lesion-recognition tasks and improved lesion grading, while supporting competitive case-level disease classification, injury grading and baseline renal function estimation. Ablations supported the combined contributions of knowledge-structured text and evidence-guided negatives, and the intermediate transfer layer improved mean lesion-recognition ROC-AUC relative to the complete projection output. A frozen language model conditioned on GloSAGE features generated glomerular descriptions. These findings suggest that teacher-derived lesion profiles can provide annotation-efficient semantic supervision for extending a glomerular visual foundation model.
zh_abstract: 视觉基础模型能够学习丰富的病理形态，但缺乏明确的概念级监督。视觉-语言预训练可以提供这种监督，但需要昂贵的图像-文本配对。在此，我们介绍 GloSAGE，一种语义自蒸馏框架，它使用预训练视觉教师模型预测的病变轮廓来构建结构化病理描述。可靠性引导选择识别图像-文本锚点，而知识结构化病理文本合成（Knowledge-Structured Pathology Text Synthesis）和证据引导负配对构建（Evidence-Guided Negative-pair Construction）用于处理部分观察到的病变。图像-文本对齐训练投影层，同时保留冻结的视觉编码器；中间语义迁移层（Semantic Transfer Layer）为下游任务提供特征。GloSAGE 在 GloMillion 上开发，并在七个肾小球水平和病例水平队列中评估，支持零样本病变识别、图像-文本检索、难负样本判别和概念干预分析。它在大多数病变识别任务中优于其源视觉模型，并改善了病变分级，同时支持具有竞争力的病例级疾病分类、损伤分级和基线肾功能估计。消融实验支持知识结构化文本和证据引导负样本的联合贡献，且中间迁移层相对于完整投影输出提高了平均病变识别 ROC-AUC。一个以 GloSAGE 特征为条件的冻结语言模型生成了肾小球描述。这些发现表明，教师模型推导的病变轮廓可以提供标注高效的语义监督，以扩展肾小球视觉基础模型。

title: Visually Irrelevant Hallucinations in Medical Vision-Language Models
zh_title: 医学视觉语言模型中的视觉无关幻觉
summary: 预印本提出CLEAR框架，在短语级估计医学视觉语言模型输出的幻觉风险，定位视觉证据并进行局部反事实扰动。
key_points: 聚焦缺乏视觉证据或与图像矛盾的表述
将回答拆解为可视觉核验的临床短语
通过局部反事实干预评估短语级对齐
reason: 评估方法有新颖性，预印本且缺乏大规模临床验证
abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) show strong performance in radiology report generation (RRG) and medical visual question answering (Med-VQA), producing free-form clinical descriptions and answers from medical images. However, they may generate clinically meaningful statements that lack visual evidence or contradict image content. We refer to these errors as visually irrelevant hallucinations and investigate them at the phrase level. We propose CLEAR (Counterfactual Localized Evaluation of Alignment and Response), a model-agnostic post-hoc framework for phrase-level hallucination risk estimation. CLEAR decomposes generated responses into visually assessable clinical phrases. For each phrase, phrase-conditioned grounding identifies a candidate visual region, which is selectively perturbed by a localized counterfactual intervention. CLEAR characterizes the intervention using two complementary auditing cues: response cues, capturing semantic and clinically meaningful changes in the generated response, and alignment cues, measuring changes in image-phrase compatibility. These cues are normalized and jointly modeled to estimate phrase-level hallucination risk. Across four datasets spanning RRG and Med-VQA, CLEAR outperforms state-of-the-art hallucination detection baselines across multiple medical and general-purpose VLMs. On MIMIC-CXR, CLEAR improves AUPRC from 85.10% to 90.23%. Its effectiveness is further validated on a GT-derived controlled VIH benchmark. These results establish visually irrelevant hallucination as an important fine-grained reliability failure mode in medical VLMs and demonstrate the value of model-agnostic visual-support auditing for more trustworthy multimodal clinical generation.
zh_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs）在放射学报告生成（radiology report generation, RRG）和医学视觉问答（medical visual question answering, Med-VQA）中表现强劲，可从医学图像生成自由形式的临床描述和答案。然而，它们可能生成具有临床意义但缺乏视觉证据或与图像内容相矛盾的陈述。我们将这类错误称为视觉无关幻觉（visually irrelevant hallucinations），并在短语层面进行研究。我们提出 CLEAR（Counterfactual Localized Evaluation of Alignment and Response，对齐与响应的反事实局部评估），一种与模型无关的事后框架，用于短语级幻觉风险评估。CLEAR将生成的响应分解为可进行视觉评估的临床短语。对于每个短语，以短语为条件的定位识别候选视觉区域，并通过局部反事实干预对该区域进行选择性扰动。CLEAR使用两种互补的审计线索来刻画该干预：响应线索，捕捉生成响应中语义和临床意义的变化；对齐线索，测量图像-短语兼容性的变化。这些线索经归一化并联合建模，以估计短语级幻觉风险。在涵盖RRG和Med-VQA的四个数据集上，CLEAR在多种医学和通用VLMs上优于最先进的幻觉检测基线。在MIMIC-CXR上，CLEAR将AUPRC从85.10%提高到90.23%。其有效性还在一个源自GT的受控VIH基准上得到进一步验证。这些结果确立了视觉无关幻觉是医学VLMs中一种重要的细粒度可靠性失效模式，并证明了与模型无关的视觉支持审计对于更可信的多模态临床生成的价值。

title: CARF: Context-Aware Reasoning Supervision for Scientific Evidence Screening
zh_title: 科学证据筛选中引入上下文感知推理监督
summary: 预印本提出CARF人机协同框架，利用专家对模型推理的反馈，使语言模型适配系统综述的标题摘要筛选。
key_points: 针对系统综述需人工筛选数千篇文献的瓶颈
在死因推断类综述上评估筛选表现
保持较高敏感度，倾向保留模糊条目
reason: 真实场景人机协同预印本，缺乏外部独立验证与大规模评估
abstract: Systematic reviews synthesize biomedical evidence to inform clinical and public-health decision-making, but require domain experts to manually screen thousands of studies against detailed eligibility criteria. We investigate whether language models can assist with this bottleneck by learning from expert feedback on title and abstract screening decisions and model-generated reasoning. We introduce the Context-Aware Reasoning Framework (CARF), a human-in-the-loop framework that uses expert feedback on model-generated reasoning to adapt language models to context-dependent screening tasks. We evaluate CARF on systematic reviews of verbal autopsy and cause-of-death ascertainment methods used in global public health mortality surveillance. CARF shows competitive screening performance compared to evaluated models while retaining high sensitivity, and is more inclined to retain ambiguous, context-dependent studies for human review. Together, these findings suggest that expert-corrected reasoning is a promising supervision signal for context-dependent scientific screening, while retaining a role for human oversight.
zh_abstract: 系统评价综合生物医学证据，为临床和公共卫生决策提供信息，但需要领域专家根据详细的纳入标准手动筛选数千项研究。我们研究语言模型能否通过从专家对标题和摘要筛选决策及模型生成推理的反馈中学习，来协助解决这一瓶颈。我们提出情境感知推理框架（Context-Aware Reasoning Framework, CARF），一种人在回路框架，利用专家对模型生成推理的反馈，使语言模型适配依赖情境的筛选任务。我们在全球公共卫生死亡监测中使用的口头尸检（verbal autopsy）和死因判定方法的系统评价上评估CARF。与所评估的模型相比，CARF显示出有竞争力的筛选性能，同时保持高敏感性，并更倾向于保留模糊的、依赖情境的研究供人工审查。总之，这些发现表明，经专家纠正的推理是依赖情境的科学筛选中有前景的监督信号，同时仍需保留人工监督的作用。

title: Responsible Quantum Machine Learning for Medical Imaging: A Fairness Audit Across Sensitive Subgroups
zh_title: 医学影像量子机器学习的分组公平性审计
summary: 预印本对皮肤病变与胸部X线分类中的经典及量子模型做公平性审计，比较三种缓解策略下的亚组差异。
key_points: 敏感属性为肤色类型与年龄组
比较SVM、MLP、QSVM、QCNN及缓解设置
量子模型总体性能可比但仍存在亚组差距
reason: 公平性审计设计较完整但为预印本，结论限于亚组指标
abstract: Quantum machine learning (QML) is increasingly explored for medical classification, yet its behaviour under subgroup-aware fairness criteria remains understudied. We present an empirical fairness audit of classical and quantum classifiers for medical imaging, assuming QML is not inherently fair. Two scenarios are evaluated: dermatological lesions on DDI (sensitive attribute: Fitzpatrick skin type) and chest X-rays on CheXpert-derived data (sensitive attribute: age group). Using ResNet-18 embeddings, we train SVM, MLP, QSVM and QCNN under a baseline and three mitigation settings: differentiable Equalized Odds (EO) regularisation, Gradient Reversal Learning (GRL), and both combined. Foundation models (PanDerm, EVA-X) serve as external references. Quantum classifiers may achieve competitive aggregate performance while still exhibiting subgroup disparities. Since a smaller subgroup AUC gap may stem from degrading the best group rather than improving the worst, each mitigation is also tested against a pre-specified non-inferiority margin relative to its baseline. Under this criterion, several configurations with the smallest disparity, notably QCNN with GRL on DDI, are not clinically acceptable due to loss of global discrimination. On DDI, QSVM with GRL+EO performed best and approached PanDerm in the performance/fairness trade-off; on CheXpert, QCNN with GRL achieved the highest aggregate performance but increased disparity, and EVA-X remained stronger. Fairness effects are model- and dataset-dependent, so QML requires empirical subgroup-aware evaluation. All quantum models run in classical simulation; we claim no quantum advantage.
zh_abstract: 量子机器学习（quantum machine learning, QML）正日益被探索用于医学分类，但其在亚组感知公平性标准下的行为仍研究不足。我们假设QML并非天然公平，并对用于医学影像的经典分类器和量子分类器进行实证公平性审计。评估两个场景：DDI上的皮肤病变（敏感属性：Fitzpatrick皮肤类型）和源自CheXpert数据的胸部X射线（敏感属性：年龄组）。使用ResNet-18嵌入，我们在基线和三种缓解设置下训练SVM、MLP、QSVM和QCNN：可微分均等赔率（Equalized Odds, EO）正则化、梯度反转学习（Gradient Reversal Learning, GRL）以及二者联合。基础模型（PanDerm、EVA-X）作为外部参照。量子分类器可能取得有竞争力的总体性能，同时仍表现出亚组差异。由于较小的亚组AUC差距可能源于降低最佳组的表现，而非改善最差组，每种缓解方法还相对于其基线，按预设的非劣效界值进行检验。根据该标准，若干差异最小的配置，尤其是DDI上采用GRL的QCNN，因全局判别能力下降而不具有临床可接受性。在DDI上，采用GRL+EO的QSVM表现最佳，并在性能/公平性权衡上接近PanDerm；在CheXpert上，采用GRL的QCNN取得最高总体性能但差异增加，EVA-X仍更强。公平性效应取决于模型和数据集，因此QML需要实证的亚组感知评估。所有量子模型均在经典模拟中运行；我们不声称具有量子优势。

title: Benchmarking decision models against generative large language models on medical multiple-choice questions
zh_title: 决策模型与生成式大模型在医学选择题上的基准比较
summary: 在1273道四选一MedQA题上比较13个决策模型与15种生成式大模型配置的准确率、成本与稳定性。
key_points: 仅文本条件、单一题库，未涉及真实临床场景
reason: 预印本基准比较有新意但无外部临床验证，属值得一看
abstract: Medical workflows often require selecting among predefined options. We compared 13 decision models with 15 generative large language model configurations, including different reasoning settings, using 1,273 four-option MedQA questions under text-only conditions. Accuracy ranged from 67.71% to 89.08% for decision models and from 78.32% to 96.86% for generative configurations. Among the tested configurations, Mercury Decide had the lowest mean final-attempt cost (USD 0.0069 per 1,000 questions), while Clef Omni had the shortest median request duration (0.291 seconds). Decision-model probabilities distinguished correct from incorrect answers, but error rates among answers assigned probabilities of at least 0.90 ranged from 1.71% to 12.77%. Answer agreement across three runs ranged from 92.30% to 100%, while probability repeatability varied. Decision models offered resource advantages alongside lower peak accuracy; selecting models for medical workflows requires considering probability quality and repeatability together with accuracy and the resources needed to detect and correct errors.
zh_abstract: 医学工作流程常需要在预定义选项中进行选择。我们在纯文本条件下，使用1,273个四选项MedQA问题，比较了13个决策模型与15种生成式大语言模型配置，包括不同的推理设置。决策模型的准确率范围为67.71%至89.08%，生成式配置为78.32%至96.86%。在受测配置中，Mercury Decide的平均最终尝试成本最低（每1,000个问题0.0069美元），而Clef Omni的请求持续时间中位数最短（0.291秒）。决策模型给出的概率可区分正确与错误答案，但在被赋予至少0.90概率的答案中，错误率范围为1.71%至12.77%。三次运行间的答案一致率范围为92.30%至100%，而概率可重复性存在差异。决策模型在峰值准确率较低的同时具有资源利用优势；为医学工作流程选择模型时，需要将概率质量和可重复性与准确率以及检测和纠正错误所需资源一并考虑。

title: PulmoWorld: An Asynchronous Multimodal Medical World Model for Longitudinal Pneumonia Dynamics
zh_title: PulmoWorld：面向肺炎纵向动态的异步多模态世界模型
summary: 提出异步多模态世界模型，统一状态估计、递归模拟与证据约束规划，用于肺炎纵向动态建模。
key_points: 按观测时刻更新共享信念，兼容缺失与异步测量
在肺炎队列MASS上递归预测与任务专用序列模型相当
规划模块仅在满足风险预算时替换默认策略
reason: 方法新颖且有队列评估，但为预印本、未述外部验证
abstract: Pneumonia changes across respiration, inflammation, and organ function, while the measurements that describe it arrive at different times and are often incomplete. We introduce PULMOWORLD, a world model for longitudinal pneumonia dynamics that connects asynchronous state estimation, recursive simulation, and evidence-constrained planning. History-aware filtering separates state propagation from observation-driven correction, so a measurement updates the shared belief only when it is observed. That belief supports recursive forecasts of clinical values and modality representations, and summaries of future prognosis. Cap-MBRL searches imagined continuations inside an authorized action set and replaces a frozen fallback only when a candidate meets the risk budget and a predicted-cost margin. On the pneumonia cohort MASS, recursive forecasts are competitive with task-trained sequence models, and simulated future states retain prognostic information. Trained separately on public MIMIC-IV-CXR chest radiographs and clinical trajectories, this model improves prognostic discrimination over latest-value fusion in development and is competitive on long-horizon error on the locked pneumonia panel. In five known-mechanism MASS-Syn environments, Cap-MBRL lowers selection regret relative to direct fallback execution.
zh_abstract: 肺炎会在呼吸、炎症和器官功能方面发生变化，而描述这些变化的测量值在不同时间到达，且往往不完整。我们提出PULMOWORLD，这是一种用于纵向肺炎动态的世界模型，连接异步状态估计、递归模拟和证据约束规划。历史感知滤波将状态传播与观测驱动校正分离，因此只有当测量值被观测到时，它才会更新共享信念。该信念支持对临床值和模态表征的递归预测，以及对未来预后的总结。Cap-MBRL在授权动作集内搜索想象出的后续轨迹，并且只有当候选方案满足风险预算和预测成本裕度时，才替换冻结的回退策略。在肺炎队列MASS上，递归预测与任务训练的序列模型相比具有竞争力，且模拟的未来状态保留了预后信息。该模型分别在公开的MIMIC-IV-CXR胸部X线片和临床轨迹上训练，在开发过程中相较最新值融合改善了预后区分能力，并在锁定的肺炎评估面板上于长时程误差方面具有竞争力。在五个已知机制的MASS-Syn环境中，Cap-MBRL相对于直接回退执行降低了选择遗憾。

title: EUReCA: End-to-End Unified CBCT Reconstruction Across Clinical Acquisitions
zh_title: EUReCA：跨临床采集条件的端到端CBCT重建
summary: 提出几何感知的前馈模型，单一权重支持8至100个投影的临床直线加速器CBCT重建。
key_points: 单一权重适配8-100个投影，无需按视角数重训
结合学习投影特征与帧内FDK重建
按采集几何将特征反投影至多分辨率3D网格
reason: 预印本方法有新意、面向放疗低剂量CBCT，但缺乏临床评估
abstract: Cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used for image-guided radiotherapy, but reducing the number of projections to lower dose and scan time makes reconstruction increasingly ill-posed. We present EUReCA (End-to-end Unified REconstruction across Clinical Acquisitions), a geometry-aware feed-forward model for variable-view clinical linac CBCT. For a given acquisition trajectory, EUReCA accepts 8-100 projections with a single set of weights, without view-count-specific retraining; the same architecture and training recipe extend unchanged to other clinical trajectories. It combines learned projection features with an in-frame Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) reconstruction. The model encodes each projection with a shared multiscale backbone, back-projects features into multiresolution 3D grids using the acquisition geometry, aggregates variable numbers of views at fixed computational cost, and refines the volume with a global 3D transformer and multilevel decoder. On simulated data, EUReCA achieved 29.9-33.2 dB PSNR with 10-100 views and outperformed all applicable feed-forward baselines; it also exceeded iterative optimization-based methods while running orders of magnitude faster. On 15 measured patient CBCT scans evaluated against vendor reconstructions, EUReCA achieved the best performance at every tested view count. These results suggest that geometry-aware, measurement-anchored feed-forward reconstruction can provide a practical and flexible foundation for variable-view linac CBCT.
zh_abstract: 锥形束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）广泛用于图像引导放疗，但减少投影数量以降低剂量和扫描时间会使重建越来越病态。我们提出EUReCA（End-to-end Unified REconstruction across Clinical Acquisitions），一种用于可变视图临床直线加速器CBCT的几何感知前馈模型。对于给定的采集轨迹，EUReCA以单一权重集接受8-100个投影，无需针对视图数量进行特定重新训练；相同的架构和训练方案可原样扩展到其他临床轨迹。它将学习到的投影特征与帧内Feldkamp-Davis-Kress（FDK）重建相结合。该模型用共享多尺度主干对每个投影进行编码，利用采集几何将特征反投影到多分辨率三维网格中，以固定计算成本聚合可变数量的视图，并用全局三维transformer和多级解码器细化体积。在模拟数据上，EUReCA在10-100个视图下达到29.9-33.2 dB PSNR，并优于所有适用的前馈基线；它还超过了基于迭代优化的方法，同时运行速度快几个数量级。在15例测量的患者CBCT扫描上针对供应商重建进行评估时，EUReCA在每个测试视图数量下均取得最佳性能。这些结果表明，几何感知、以测量为锚定的前馈重建可为可变视图直线加速器CBCT提供实用且灵活的基础。

title: SparseTokenGS: Gaussian-based Sparse-View CBCT Reconstruction via Reusable Token Pool
zh_title: SparseTokenGS：可复用令牌池的稀疏视角CBCT重建
summary: 预印本提出基于高斯表示与可复用令牌池的稀疏视角锥束CT重建方法，旨在缓解伪影与全场信息不可复用问题。
key_points: 提出锚点令牌融合与点-令牌注意力
针对重建场固定后无法回取全场信息
面向牙科与图像引导介入的低剂量成像
reason: 有新意的预印本重建方法，但无外部数据或临床评估，属值得一看档
abstract: Sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography is widely used for fast, low-dose volumetric imaging and lesion localization in dentistry and image-guided interventions, but it introduces severe artifacts. Feed-forward Gaussian methods transfer the reconstruction cost to training and decode each coordinate from projection-aligned features and neighboring anchors. However, information from the whole scan is written only when the field is constructed and cannot be retrieved during coordinate decoding, leaving the volume inconsistent within the scan. This is a common limitation of such methods: once the field is fixed, decoding uses only local features and reconstruction quality drops substantially. We propose SparseTokenGS, a Gaussian-based method for sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography reconstruction via a reusable token pool. Anchor Token Fusion and Point-Token Attention query this shared pool at the anchors and at the query coordinates, respectively. The local Gaussian prior is retained, and the volume is reconstructed in one forward pass, without per-scan optimization or a projection-domain loss. On three public chest and dental datasets, SparseTokenGS achieves the highest reconstruction performance among the compared methods. On clinical dental scans, reconstruction from only six projections reaches 29.51 decibels in peak signal-to-noise ratio and a structural similarity of 0.842 against the full-view reference, and off-the-shelf tooth-and-pulp segmentation keeps these structures separable for root-canal localization. Experiments on volcanic rock and chicken show performance after same-object adaptation. A reusable token pool gives feed-forward reconstruction a mechanism that keeps scan-wide context available through decoding and can benefit future rapid clinical lesion localization and analysis. The code is available at: https://github.com/FrankDengAI/SparseTokenGS.

abstract: [Diagnostic microbiology and infectious disease] Bacterial infections remain a major global health challenge, which are responsible for significant morbidity, mortality, and increasing antimicrobial resistance worldwide. Rapid and accurate identification of bacterial pathogens is therefore essential for guiding appropriate antimicrobial therapy, improving patient outcomes, and supporting effective infection control strategies. However, conventional microbiological diagnostic methods such as culture, microscopy, and biochemical testing are often time-consuming, labor-intensive, and dependent on expert interpretation. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) has increasingly emerged as a powerful tool capable of transforming clinical microbiology by enabling rapid analysis of complex biomedical data. This review aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the role of AI in the diagnosis and identification of bacterial pathogens and to discuss its current applications, advantages, limitations, and future perspectives. Key AI-assisted technologies, including machine learning and deep learning algorithms such as Random Forest, Support Vector Machines, Artificial Neural Networks, and Convolutional Neural Networks, are increasingly applied to diagnostic platforms, including automated microscopy, next-generation genomic sequencing, MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry, and clinical data analysis systems. Current evidence indicates that AI-assisted diagnostic approaches can substantially improve the speed, accuracy, and automation of microbial pathogen detection while enabling large-scale analysis of microbiological and clinical datasets. In the future, AI-integrated microbiology laboratories, rapid diagnostic platforms, genomic surveillance systems, and AI-assisted clinical decision support tools are expected to further enhance infectious disease diagnostics and contribute to improved antimicrobial stewardship and global infection management.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostic microbiology and infectious disease] 细菌感染仍然是重大全球健康挑战，在全球范围内导致显著发病率、死亡率和日益增加的抗菌药物耐药性。因此，快速准确识别细菌病原体对于指导适当抗菌治疗、改善患者结局和支持有效感染控制策略至关重要。然而，传统微生物学诊断方法如培养、显微镜检查和生化检测通常耗时、劳动密集且依赖专家判读。近年来，人工智能（AI）日益成为一种强大工具，能够通过快速分析复杂生物医学数据来改变临床微生物学。本综述旨在全面概述AI在细菌病原体诊断和识别中的作用，并讨论其当前应用、优势、局限性和未来前景。关键AI辅助技术，包括机器学习和深度学习算法，如随机森林（Random Forest）、支持向量机（Support Vector Machines）、人工神经网络（Artificial Neural Networks）和卷积神经网络（Convolutional Neural Networks），正日益应用于诊断平台，包括自动显微镜检查、下一代基因组测序、MALDI-TOF质谱和临床数据分析系统。当前证据表明，AI辅助诊断方法可显著提高微生物病原体检测的速度、准确性和自动化程度，同时能够对微生物学和临床数据集进行大规模分析。未来，AI整合的微生物学实验室、快速诊断平台、基因组监测系统和AI辅助临床决策支持工具有望进一步增强传染病诊断，并促进改善抗菌药物管理和全球感染管理。

abstract: Radiomics extracts quantitative features describing tumor shape, intensity, and texture from medical images to build models that predict clinical outcomes. However, large feature sets increase the risk of overfitting in small datasets, and building an end-to-end workflow often requires programming expertise. We present MEDiml (Medical Image Analysis with Machine Learning), open-source radiomics software available as a Python package (MEDiml-pkg) and a no-code desktop application (MEDiml-app). Both run on the same computational engine, and code generation exports graphically configured workflows as executable Python code. Feature extraction follows the Image Biomarker Standardization Initiative (IBSI) standards. MEDiml is built around complexity minimization: features are grouped into levels of increasing complexity (morphological, intensity, textural,l and filter-based), a model is trained at each level, and the simplest level not significantly outperformed by more complex ones is retained. Applied to five oncological datasets (2,104 scans), MEDiml achieved AUCs of 0.65 to 0.82, with morphological or intensity features sufficient in four of the five tasks. Resources: www.mediml.app.

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Istanbul Medipol University Hospital; conditions: Nursing Education, Nursing Process, Learning Outcome, Generative Artificial Intelligence; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 173; status: COMPLETED] This randomized controlled trial evaluated the effect of generative artificial intelligence (AI)-supported education in teaching the nursing process on nursing students' learning outcomes. The study was conducted with undergraduate nursing students enrolled in the Nursing Process course for the first time at a foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye. After a 7-week instructor-centered theoretical course, students were randomly assigned to an intervention or control group using computer-based simple randomization. Over three consecutive weeks, the intervention group worked on three patient case scenarios using a generative AI platform (Gemini), guided by pre-defined themes and prompts covering data collection, nursing diagnosis, planning, and implementation. The accuracy, consistency, and alignment of AI-generated responses with the nursing process steps were then discussed in class. During the same period, the control group completed three different case studies using the instructor's standard care plan template. Nursing process knowledge, self-efficacy in clinical performance, and clinical decision-making confidence and anxiety were measured before and after the intervention, and attitudes toward artificial intelligence and the course were measured after the intervention. A total of 173 eligible students were randomized (intervention n = 85; control n = 88), and the study was completed with 140 students (intervention n = 68; control n = 72). Students who were repeating the course or were horizontal or vertical transfer students were excluded. The primary outcome was nursing process knowledge, measured with a researcher-developed Nursing Process Knowledge Test. Secondary outcomes were measured with the Self-Efficacy in Clinical Performance Scale, the Nursing Anxiety and Self-Confidence with Clinical Decision Making Scale, and the Attitude Toward Artificial Intelligence and Its Course Scale. Data were collected through electronic forms and analyzed using IBM SPSS 22.0.

abstract: [Toxicology in vitro : an international journal published in association with BIBRA] Micro- and nanoplastics (MNPs) released from food contact materials (FCMs) present a risk-assessment challenge because exposure depends not only on mass concentration but also on particle size, number, morphology, polymer identity, surface properties, aggregation, transformation, and co-migration of additives and non-intentionally added substances. Conventional approaches remain fragmented and are poorly suited to translating FCM-specific particle release into human-relevant internal dosimetry and mechanistic toxicity. This review proposes a particle-adapted next-generation risk assessment (NGRA) framework integrating FCM release characterization, gastrointestinal transformation and absorbed fraction, physiologically based toxicokinetic (PBK/PBTK) modelling, adverse outcome pathways (AOPs), and explainable artificial intelligence (XAI). The framework explicitly defines data hand-offs between modules, including particle-specific exposure metrics, internal particle burden, persistence and clearance parameters, key-event evidence, and model uncertainty. AOPs are used to organize mechanistic evidence rather than infer causality, while XAI is positioned as an interpretability and prioritization tool subject to applicability-domain assessment, external validation, reproducibility, and uncertainty analysis. Attention is given to distinguishing particle-mediated effects from those associated with co-migrating additives and non-intentionally added substances. Regulatory translation is considered in the context of FCM migration assessment and emerging NAM-based approaches. The framework provides a basis for evidence integration, testing prioritization, and future quantitative regulatory assessment of FCM-derived MNPs.
zh_abstract: [Toxicology in vitro：an international journal published in association with BIBRA] 从食品接触材料（FCMs）中释放的微塑料和纳米塑料（MNPs）构成风险评估挑战，因为暴露不仅取决于质量浓度，还取决于粒径、颗粒数、形态、聚合物身份、表面性质、聚集、转化以及添加剂和非有意添加物质的共迁移。传统方法仍然零散，难以将FCM特异性颗粒释放转化为与人体相关的内剂量学和机制毒性。本综述提出一个适配颗粒的下一代风险评估（NGRA）框架，整合FCM释放表征、胃肠道转化和吸收分数、基于生理的毒代动力学（PBK/PBTK）建模、不良结局通路（AOPs）和可解释人工智能（XAI）。该框架明确界定模块之间的数据交接，包括颗粒特异性暴露指标、体内颗粒负荷、持久性和清除参数、关键事件证据以及模型不确定性。AOPs用于组织机制证据，而非推断因果关系；XAI被定位为可解释性和优先级排序工具，需接受适用域评估、外部验证、可重复性和不确定性分析。关注区分颗粒介导的效应与共迁移添加剂及非有意添加物质相关的效应。在FCM迁移评估和新兴基于NAM的方法背景下考虑监管转化。该框架为证据整合、测试优先级排序以及未来对FCM来源MNPs的定量监管评估提供基础。

abstract: Purpose. Characterizing glioma heterogeneity requires measurements that retain the physical scale and orientation of intratumoral intensity dependence. We evaluate the original 3D variographic field produced by the MUSE tool (Modeling Uncertainty as a Support for the Environment) alongside directional radiomics and independent image-based molecular classification. Methods. We analyzed postcontrast T1-weighted magnetic resonance images and enhancing-tumor segmentations from the public UCSF-PDGM collection. Verified MUSE outputs were available for 416 independent baseline patients, of whom 375 had paired directional gray-level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) measurements. Each MUSE field retained 328 original experimental directional variograms with physical lag distances, semivariances, orientations, and voxel-pair support. Agreement was assessed at aligned offsets and through between-tumor comparisons. Patient-level permutation tests evaluated associations with isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) status on 2,508 native direction-lag coordinates. A standalone 3D residual convolutional neural network (CNN) provided a separate IDH classification benchmark. Results. At 9,371 geometrically aligned offsets, native MUSE semivariance and half GLCM contrast correlated strongly (Pearson r = 0.954). Across 31,599 eligible between-tumor comparisons, representation-level dissimilarities showed Spearman {rho}_S = 0.862, with sensitivity to GLCM feature family and long-offset sampling support. In 364 grade-4 tumors, including 24 IDH-mutant cases, the original MUSE field was associated with IDH after conventional adjustment (global permutation p = 0.00050), but the association was attenuated after primary directional GLCM adjustment (p = 0.256). The independent CNN achieved an out-of-fold IDH ROC-AUC of 0.792 and PR-AUC of 0.414 across 416 patients. Native MUSE examples revealed scale- and direction-dependent spatial behavior, including distances beyond those sampled by the GLCM protocol. Conclusion. Variograms by MUSE provide a physically indexed description of tumor spatial heterogeneity that can accompany radiomic analysis and CNN classification. The observed statistical overlap is substantial, and incremental clinical discrimination beyond directional GLCM features remains unestablished.
zh_abstract: 【目的】刻画胶质瘤异质性需要能够保留瘤内强度依赖性的物理尺度和方向的测量。我们评估 MUSE 工具（Modeling Uncertainty as a Support for the Environment）生成的原始三维变异函数场（3D variographic field），并将其与方向性放射组学（directional radiomics）和独立的基于图像的分子分类进行比较。【方法】我们分析了来自公开 UCSF-PDGM 数据集的增强后 T1 加权磁共振图像和强化肿瘤分割。416 名独立基线患者有经验证的 MUSE 输出，其中 375 名具有配对的方向性灰度共生矩阵（GLCM）测量。每个 MUSE 场保留了 328 个原始实验方向变异函数，包含物理滞后距离、半方差、方向以及体素对支持。在对齐偏移处以及通过肿瘤间比较评估一致性。患者水平置换检验在 2,508 个原始方向-滞后坐标上评估与异柠檬酸脱氢酶（IDH）状态的关联。一个独立的 3D 残差卷积神经网络（CNN）提供了单独的 IDH 分类基准。【结果】在 9,371 个几何对齐偏移处，原始 MUSE 半方差与半数 GLCM 对比度强相关（Pearson r = 0.954）。在 31,599 个符合条件的肿瘤间比较中，表征水平差异显示 Spearman ρ_S = 0.862，并对 GLCM 特征家族和长偏移采样支持具有敏感性。在 364 个 4 级肿瘤中（包括 24 个 IDH 突变病例），原始 MUSE 场在常规调整后与 IDH 相关（全局置换 p = 0.00050），但在主要方向性 GLCM 调整后该关联减弱（p = 0.256）。独立 CNN 在 416 名患者中取得 0.792 的折外 IDH ROC-AUC 和 0.414 的 PR-AUC。原始 MUSE 示例揭示了尺度和方向依赖的空间行为，包括超出 GLCM 方案所采样距离的范围。【结论】MUSE 的变异函数提供了肿瘤空间异质性的物理索引描述，可作为放射组学分析和 CNN 分类的补充。观察到的统计重叠很大，而超越方向性 GLCM 特征的增量临床判别能力仍未确立。

title: Auditable Hierarchical Inference with Multimodal Evidence and Bayesian Active Inquiry
zh_title: 多模态证据与贝叶斯主动询问的可审计分层推理
summary: 用合成舌象、脉压与声学观测做序贯贝叶斯问诊评估，600例合成测试中家族判别准确率87%。
key_points: 区分客观多模态推断与主动问诊的合成评测框架
25个类型化问题逐步收窄至33个细术语
代价敏感信息增益将家族准确率提至95.5%
reason: 仅合成数据评测，无真实临床验证，属增量证据
abstract: Most multimodal classifiers assume that all useful evidence is available upfront, whereas clinical inquiry is sequential. We present a synthetic evaluation framework separating objective multimodal inference from active inquiry. An objective model maps synthetic tongue, bilateral multipressure pulse, and acoustic observations to eight syndrome families. A provenance-bearing Knowledge Core and training-only answer model support Bayesian narrowing over 33 fine terms using 25 typed questions, while seven safety questions remain outside the diagnostic posterior. Weak shared symptom factors limit fine-term influence on objective phenotypes, and an objective-only probe tests leakage. In a preregistered 600-case synthetic evaluation, objective family accuracy was 87.0%. Cost-sensitive expected information gain (cost-EIG) raised family accuracy to 95.5% and exact fine-term accuracy to 42.5%, versus 92.7% and 33.0% for an unoptimized fixed-order baseline. Selective family accuracy reached 96.9% at 95.3% coverage. However, cost-EIG asked more questions on average than fixed order (9.795 versus 9.352). Missing-audio routing retained 94.0% family accuracy, and a workflow invariant enforced abstention when all objective modalities were absent. Permuting fine-term answer likelihoods reduced family accuracy to 78.7%. Five of six frozen checks passed, but the question-efficiency hypothesis failed. Comparisons are descriptive because only aggregate, not paired case-level, outputs were retained. These results establish a reproducible synthetic workflow, not clinical diagnostic or treatment validity.
zh_abstract: 大多数多模态分类器假设所有有用的证据都预先可用，而临床问诊是序贯的。我们提出一个合成评估框架，将客观多模态推断与主动问诊分开。一个客观模型将合成的舌象、双侧多压力脉搏和声学观察映射到八个证候家族。一个带来源信息（provenance-bearing）的知识核心（Knowledge Core）和一个仅用于训练的答案模型支持使用25个类型化问题在33个细术语上进行贝叶斯收窄，同时七个安全性问题保留在诊断后验之外。弱的共享症状因子限制了细术语对客观表型的影响，并且一个仅客观探针测试泄漏。在一项预注册的600例合成评估中，客观家族准确率为87.0%。成本敏感期望信息增益（cost-sensitive expected information gain, cost-EIG）将家族准确率提高到95.5%，将确切细术语准确率提高到42.5%，而未优化的固定顺序基线分别为92.7%和33.0%。选择性家族准确率在95.3%覆盖率下达到96.9%。然而，cost-EIG平均比固定顺序询问更多问题（9.795对9.352）。缺失音频路由保留了94.0%的家族准确率，并且当所有客观模态均缺失时，工作流不变量强制弃权。置换细术语答案似然将家族准确率降低到78.7%。六项冻结检查中有五项通过，但问题效率假设未通过。比较是描述性的，因为仅保留了聚合输出，而非配对病例级输出。这些结果建立了一个可重复的合成工作流，而非临床诊断或治疗有效性。

title: Alpha-TCM: A Nine-Layer Framework for TCM-Guided Multimodal Inference and Structured-Prior Auditing
zh_title: Alpha-TCM：中医引导的多模态推理九层框架
summary: 预印本提出面向中医的多层可审计架构，仅以合成数据实例化前五层，作者声明非完整临床实现。
key_points: 九层架构覆盖语义定义、采集、质控到治理
仅合成舌象、脉波等数据验证第1-5层
强调知识、证据与推断分离以便审计
reason: 系统设计提案加合成数据原型，无真实临床验证，属增量档
abstract: Alpha-TCM makes two contributions under a central thesis: auditable systems should separate domain knowledge, case evidence, probabilistic inference, and downstream authority. First, it proposes a nine-layer TCM-oriented architecture covering semantic definitions, multimodal acquisition, quality control, provenance-bearing knowledge, probabilistic inference, longitudinal updating, constrained decisions, language interaction, and human governance. Each layer specifies its information contract, failure boundary, dependencies, and validation status. This is a system-design proposal, not a claim of complete clinical implementation. Second, a controlled synthetic prototype instantiates Layers 1-5 to audit the knowledge-evidence interface. Four conditional-Gaussian encoders process synthetic tongue images, pulse waveforms, inquiry fields, and text, while a frozen bridge predicts a five-dimensional synthetic outcome. A versioned contextual prior is compiled independently of the renderer. Fusion removes duplicated reference-prior information before adding context. Equal-information controls, prior regularization, graded contamination, and structural corruption test contextual benefits, Bayesian specificity, and conflict detection. Across ten paired seeds and four training sizes, contextual knowledge improved mean absolute error over marginal committee fusion at 600 and 1,200 cases, but not over equal-information neural controls. Fully incorrect context harmed performance at every size, while prior effects were inconsistent and conflict scores did not track case-level damage. The results support contextual structure in low-data synthetic settings, not a specifically Bayesian advantage. The prototype establishes no claims about TCM theory or clinical, diagnostic, therapeutic, causal, longitudinal, or transfer validity.
zh_abstract: Alpha-TCM 在一个核心论点下做出两项贡献：可审计系统应将领域知识、病例证据、概率推断和下游权限分开。首先，它提出一个面向中医的九层架构，涵盖语义定义、多模态采集、质量控制、带来源信息的知识、概率推断、纵向更新、约束决策、语言交互和人类治理。每一层规定其信息契约、失效边界、依赖关系和验证状态。这是一个系统设计提案，而非完整临床实施的声明。其次，一个受控合成原型实例化第1-5层以审计知识-证据接口。四个条件高斯编码器处理合成舌图像、脉搏波形、问诊字段和文本，而一个冻结桥接器预测五维合成结局。一个版本化上下文先验独立于渲染器编译。融合在添加上下文之前移除重复的参考先验信息。等量信息对照、先验正则化、分级污染和结构损坏测试上下文收益、贝叶斯特异性和冲突检测。在十个配对种子和四种训练规模上，上下文知识在600和1,200例时相对于边际委员会融合改善了平均绝对误差，但相对于等量信息神经对照没有改善。完全错误的上下文在每种规模下都损害性能，而先验效应不一致，冲突分数未追踪病例级损害。结果支持低数据合成环境中的上下文结构，而非特定的贝叶斯优势。该原型不对中医理论或临床、诊断、治疗、因果、纵向或迁移有效性建立任何主张。

title: Detecting Brain Cancer Progression Through Signatures of Wearable Accelerometry Data
zh_title: 可穿戴加速度计信号检测脑癌进展
summary: 研究利用腕戴加速度计数据与粗糙路径签名特征，分类高级别胶质瘤患者稳定与进展状态。
key_points: 高级别胶质瘤常规用增强MRI每2-3月评估
加速度计可连续无创监测患者功能
将记录转为步行路径片段并提取签名特征
reason: 预印本、单研究可穿戴方法，摘要无样本量与对照结果，属增量档
abstract: Glioblastoma and other high-grade gliomas (HGG) have a poor prognosis and are associated with progressive functional decline. The standard of care to assess progressive disease is contrast-enhanced MRI, which is expensive, claustrophobic, and performed only once every 2-3 months. Wearable accelerometers offer a non-invasive alternative for continuously monitoring patient function between clinic visits. However, accelerometry data streams are typically noisy and highly patient-specific, making conventional time series methods and summary statistics poorly suited to detecting clinically meaningful change. This work aims to classify stable versus progressive disease states by applying rough path signatures for feature extraction from wrist-worn accelerometer data. We convert accelerometer recordings from HGG patients enrolled in the BrainWear study into walking-path segments and use signature kernel maximum mean discrepancy (SigMMD) to quantify change in patients' walking behaviour. We overcome the challenge of inter-patient heterogeneity by adjusting for the natural variation in a patient's walking during stable tumour periods. This patient-specific normalisation substantially improves separation, yielding a candidate biomarker of tumour progression. Our results provide proof-of-concept evidence that signature-based analysis of wearable accelerometry can distinguish stable from progressive disease states, motivating larger longitudinal studies of continuous wearable monitoring as a digital biomarker in neuro-oncology.
zh_abstract: 胶质母细胞瘤和其他高级别胶质瘤（HGG）预后较差，并与进行性功能下降相关。评估疾病进展的标准方法是增强MRI，但其费用高、可能引起幽闭恐惧，并且每2—3个月仅进行一次。可穿戴加速度计提供了一种非侵入性替代方法，可在门诊就诊之间连续监测患者功能。然而，加速度计数据流通常噪声大且高度具有患者特异性，使传统时间序列方法和汇总统计量不适用于检测具有临床意义的变化。本研究旨在通过应用粗糙路径签名从腕戴式加速度计数据中提取特征，对稳定与进展性疾病状态进行分类。我们将BrainWear研究中入组的HGG患者的加速度计记录转换为行走路径片段，并使用签名核最大均值差异（SigMMD）量化患者行走行为的变化。我们通过校正患者在肿瘤稳定期行走的自然变异，克服了患者间异质性的挑战。这种患者特异性归一化显著改善了区分度，产生了肿瘤进展的候选生物标志物。我们的结果提供了概念验证证据，表明对可穿戴加速度计数据进行基于签名的分析能够区分稳定与进展性疾病状态，从而推动开展更大规模的纵向研究，将连续可穿戴监测作为神经肿瘤学中的数字生物标志物。

title: Algorithmic Bias from the Perspectives of Healthcare Professionals
zh_title: 医护人员视角下的医疗算法偏见

感知公平与算法接受和采用相关

abstract: This paper focuses on algorithmic bias of machine learning and artificial intelligence applications in healthcare information systems. Based on the quantitative data and qualitative comments from a survey and interviews with healthcare professionals, who have different job roles (e.g., clinical vs. administrative), this study provides findings about the relationships between algorithmic bias, perceived fairness, and the intended acceptance and adoption of ML algorithms and algorithm generated outcomes. The results suggest that the opinions of healthcare professionals toward the causes of algorithmic bias, the criteria of algorithm assessment, the perceived fairness, and bias mitigation approaches may vary depending on their job roles, perspectives, tasks, and the algorithm characteristics. More research is needed to investigate algorithmic bias to ensure fairness and equality in healthcare.
zh_abstract: 本文关注医疗信息系统中机器学习（machine learning）与人工智能（artificial intelligence）应用的算法偏见。基于对具有不同岗位角色（如临床与行政）的医疗专业人员的问卷调查和访谈所获定量数据与定性评论，本研究提供了关于算法偏见、感知公平性以及预期接受和采用机器学习算法及算法生成结果之间关系的发现。结果表明，医疗专业人员对算法偏见成因、算法评估标准、感知公平性和偏见缓解方法的看法，可能因其岗位角色、视角、任务和算法特征而异。需要更多研究来调查算法偏见，以确保医疗中的公平与平等。

title: DES-JEPA: Learning a Shared Vocabulary for High-Dimensional Discrete Event Sequences
zh_title: DES-JEPA：高维离散事件序列的共享词表学习
summary: 提出DES-JEPA联合嵌入预测架构，为跨领域高维离散事件序列（含患者临床事件轨迹）学习共享离散词表。
key_points: 针对事件类型数量庞大、跨域标签不对应的难题
现有事件序列基础模型仅支持少量固定事件类型
摘要未给出临床数据集上的量化结果
reason: 方法类预印本，临床评估信息不足，属增量档
abstract: Temporal foundation models such as Chronos and TimesFM generalize across domains through a shared numerical observation space. In contrast, discrete event sequences (DESs), including operational event logs or patient clinical-event trajectories, have domain-specific event vocabularies whose labels lack a consistent correspondence across domains. Beyond this lack of consistency, the number of distinct events in real-world settings is high enough to challenge both classical temporal point process modeling and current in-context foundation inference models such as FIM-PP. Critically, current foundation models for DESs are limited to a small, fixed number of event types, restricting their applicability to realistic, high-dimensional event streams. To address this, we propose two complementary modules: (i) DES-JEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architecture that learns a shared discrete vocabulary from synthetic stochastic processes with unaligned event vocabularies; and (ii) DES-PFN, a discrete event sequence prior-fitted network that reuses the learned vocabulary for in-context next-event prediction. Without task-specific fine-tuning, this framework achieves competitive zero-shot performance on eight unseen real-world datasets and scales up to 700 distinct event types.
zh_abstract: 诸如Chronos和TimesFM的时间基础模型通过共享的数值观测空间实现跨领域泛化。相比之下，离散事件序列（discrete event sequences, DESs），包括运营事件日志或患者临床事件轨迹，具有领域特定的事件词表，其标签在跨领域间缺乏一致对应关系。除了这种不一致性外，真实环境中不同事件的数量高到足以挑战经典时间点过程建模和当前上下文基础推理模型（如FIM-PP）。关键的是，当前用于DES的基础模型受限于少量固定数量的事件类型，限制了其适用于现实的高维事件流。为解决此问题，我们提出两个互补模块：（i）DES-JEPA，一种联合嵌入预测架构，从未对齐事件词表的合成随机过程中学习共享离散词表；（ii）DES-PFN，一种离散事件序列先验拟合网络，复用已学习词表进行上下文下一事件预测。无需任务特定微调，该框架在八个未见真实世界数据集上取得有竞争力的零样本性能，并可扩展至700种不同事件类型。

title: LLMs as Judges and Examinees for Medical Item Difficulty Prediction
zh_title: 以大模型作为评判者与考生预测医学试题难度
summary: 用开源大模型对USMLE与PANCE题目作难度评分、配对比较及模拟作答，融合信号预测试题难度。
key_points: 利用评判与应试两类信号替代纯文本特征
数据来自美国医师执照类考试题库
摘要未披露最终预测性能指标
reason: 医学教育场景预印本，结果信息有限，属增量档
abstract: Predicting medical item difficulty from item text alone remains challenging. Prior work has largely relied on linguistic features or text representations derived from general-purpose and domain-specific language models, but predictive performance has remained modest. This study takes a different approach by using difficulty-related signals that emerge when open-weight large language models (LLMs) interact with test items. Using USMLE and PANCE medical licensure examination items, we examined LLMs in two roles. As judges, the models provided absolute difficulty ratings and pairwise difficulty comparisons. As simulated examinees, they generated response-based signals including correctness, keyed-option probability, response entropy, and the probability margin between the top two options. We then combined the strongest judgment and response signals with baseline item features in downstream prediction models. Pairwise difficulty judgment was the most consistent individual LLM signal across both datasets, while simulated-examinee signals and absolute judgments provided complementary information in some feature combinations. The best configurations reached a Spearman correlation of $ρ$ = .447 on USMLE, exceeding the best system in the 2024 BEA shared task ($ρ$ = .25), and $ρ$ = .494 on PANCE. These results were comparable to direct absolute judgments from the proprietary frontier model Claude Opus 5 ($ρ$ = .443 and .488, respectively). Overall, judgment and response signals from open-weight LLMs captured difficulty-related information beyond text representations. Because these models can be deployed locally, the approach offers a practical option for predicting the difficulty of unreleased or high-security test items.
zh_abstract: 仅凭试题文本预测医学试题难度仍然具有挑战性。既往工作在很大程度上依赖于语言学特征或由通用语言模型和领域专用语言模型得到的文本表征，但预测性能一直较为有限。本研究采取了一种不同方法，利用开放权重大型语言模型（LLMs）与试题交互时出现的难度相关信号。我们使用USMLE和PANCE医师资格考试试题，考察了LLMs的两种角色。作为评判者，模型提供绝对难度评分和成对难度比较。作为模拟考生，模型生成基于作答的信号，包括正确性、计分选项概率、作答熵以及前两个选项之间的概率差。随后，我们在下游预测模型中将最强的评判信号和作答信号与基线试题特征相结合。成对难度判断是两个数据集中最一致的单个LLM信号，而模拟考生信号和绝对判断在某些特征组合中提供了互补信息。最佳配置在USMLE上达到Spearman相关系数 $ρ$ = .447，超过2024年BEA共享任务中的最佳系统（$ρ$ = .25），并在PANCE上达到 $ρ$ = .494。这些结果与专有前沿模型Claude Opus 5给出的直接绝对判断相当（分别为 $ρ$ = .443和.488）。总体而言，开放权重LLMs的评判信号和作答信号捕获了超出文本表征的难度相关信息。由于这些模型可在本地部署，该方法为预测未发布或高保密性试题的难度提供了一种实用选择。

summary: 构建融合傅里叶频域增强与交叉注意力的多组学模型，预测20种AAV衣壳变体在52个癌细胞系的感染性。

低假阳性率条件下适用于高通量筛选
对未见血清型泛化较差

abstract: [Viruses] This work builds AAV-CapNet, a deep learning model integrating Fourier frequency enhancement and cross-attention fusion, to predict the infectivity of 20 AAV capsid variants across 52 cancer cell lines with a self-built multi-omics dataset of 392 validated measurements. Validated via stratified splitting and repeated five-fold cross-validation, it extracts dual-domain capsid features fused with host transcriptomics for joint classification and regression. The model exhibits favourable performance under low-false-positive-rate conditions suitable for high-throughput screening. Attention mapping and ablation tests validate core modules' necessity. Despite poor generalization to unseen serotypes, this interpretable tool facilitates intraserotype capsid screening and rational engineering.

abstract: Computing optimal transport maps between medical images plays a fundamental role in morphological analysis. However, existing methods are either difficult to scale to large 3D medical images or rely on regularized formulations that provide only approximate transport maps. To improve the accuracy of downstream medical image analysis, we propose a novel approach for estimating optimal transport maps by parameterizing the convex potential function. By construction, the resulting transport map is guaranteed to be curl-free, consistent with Brenier's theorem. We evaluate the proposed method on both 2D and 3D medical imaging datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves lower transport estimation errors and produces higher-quality image reconstructions than existing methods.

abstract: Walking offers a window into physical function that may support interpretable video-based frailty assessment. We developed silhouette-based "gaitomics" to connect frailty predictions with measurable patterns of body configuration and movement. In 66 older adults assessed using the Fried Frailty Phenotype, standardized silhouettes and gait energy images yielded 90 descriptors of shape, temporal variation, motion, and texture. Minimum redundancy maximum relevance selection using the mutual information difference criterion prioritized informative features while limiting redundancy. Each classifier was evaluated using nested stratified cross-validation with five outer and three inner folds at the participant level, with feature ranking and feature-count selection confined to training partitions. Shapley additive explanations examined contributions to held-out predictions. Bilateral silhouette difference led the aggregate feature-selection rankings for three-class classification and both comparisons involving frail participants. Attribution profiles differed across tasks, with texture and consecutive-frame silhouette differences prominent in three-class classification. Among classifier-specific evaluations, CatBoost achieved the highest mean three-class micro-AUC of 0.647 \pm 0.085. Leading pairwise mean micro-AUCs were 0.833 \pm 0.249 for frail versus nonfrail, 0.765 \pm 0.168 for frail versus prefrail, and 0.554 \pm 0.129 for prefrail versus nonfrail classification. These findings connect model predictions to explicit gait characteristics while revealing task-dependent feature priorities and limited separation of prefrail and nonfrail participants. The framework provides an interpretable basis for further investigation, with larger independent studies needed to establish reliability and clinical relevance.
zh_abstract: 步行为了解身体功能提供了一个窗口，可能支持可解释的基于视频的衰弱评估。我们开发了基于轮廓的“步态组学”（gaitomics），将衰弱预测与可测量的身体形态和运动模式联系起来。在66名使用Fried衰弱表型（Fried Frailty Phenotype）评估的老年人中，标准化轮廓和步态能量图像产生了90个描述形状、时间变化、运动和纹理的描述符。使用互信息差准则的最小冗余最大相关选择优先选择信息丰富的特征，同时限制冗余。每个分类器均在参与者层面采用五折外层和三折内层的嵌套分层交叉验证进行评估，特征排序和特征数量选择仅限于训练分区。Shapley加性解释检查了对留出预测的贡献。双侧轮廓差异在三分类以及涉及衰弱参与者的两项比较的汇总特征选择排名中居首。归因谱在不同任务间存在差异，其中纹理和连续帧轮廓差异在三分类中突出。在分类器特异性评估中，CatBoost取得了最高的平均三分类micro-AUC，为0.647 ± 0.085。领先的两两比较平均micro-AUC分别为：衰弱 vs 非衰弱为0.833 ± 0.249，衰弱 vs 前衰弱为0.765 ± 0.168，前衰弱 vs 非衰弱分类为0.554 ± 0.129。这些发现将模型预测与明确的步态特征联系起来，同时揭示了任务依赖性的特征优先级以及前衰弱与非衰弱参与者区分有限。该框架为进一步研究提供了可解释的基础，但仍需要更大规模的独立研究来确定其可靠性和临床相关性。

abstract: Implicit neural representation (INR) methods for deformable medical image registration require the network parameters to be optimized for each new image pair, making adaptation speed a practical limitation. This work investigates whether early adaptation can be accelerated using an initialization learned from a collection of previously solved registration tasks. We examine two schemes: Reptile meta-initialization and STRAINER transfer of the shared component of a coordinate network. KAN-IDIR is used as the base INR displacement-field model. Experiments are conducted on OASIS-1, with 364 consecutive pairs used for training and 49 pairs for test-time adaptation. Registration quality is evaluated using mean Dice and HD95, together with the fraction of voxels with a negative Jacobian determinant at iteration 1500. In the configurations studied, both schemes yield higher Dice and lower HD95 at early iterations than random initialization. Reptile numerically outperforms STRAINER under a small iteration budget, although their pretraining budgets are not matched. As the number of iterations increases, the differences between the schemes shrink. STRAINER pretraining takes 39-40 minutes, compared with 44.98 hours for Reptile.

abstract: [OTA international : the open access journal of orthopaedic trauma] Artificial Intelligence (AI) is an ascendant technical field with potential to revolutionize health care and orthopaedics. This paper highlights ways in which AI is already affecting members of the Orthopaedic Trauma Association (OTA), while identifying paths to clinical application, as presented at the 2025 OTA Annual Meeting's Basic Science Focus Forum. A report from the OTA AI Task Force shared some initial accomplishments, including the crafting of a position statement. Areas of AI application in orthopaedic trauma were discussed, including the prediction of fall risk in the elderly, capabilities for automated image-based diagnosis and outcome assessment, and efforts toward creating a framework for in silico clinical trials that rely upon virtual patient cohorts. Together these applications show how AI is emerging as a foundational tool in orthopaedic trauma research. Over the next few years, these products will be moving from the research laboratory to the clinic. For the tools to be of greatest benefit, a measured development approach using teams of data scientists partnered with orthopaedic trauma surgeons must be adopted. Academia and Industry are both progressing in this direction-the best path forward will likely involve shared development efforts. As these efforts progress, OTA members will undoubtedly be involved. Both they and their patients stand to be the primary beneficiaries of many of these developments.
zh_abstract: [OTA International：骨科创伤开放获取期刊] 人工智能（AI）是一个新兴技术领域，有潜力彻底改变医疗保健和骨科。本文强调AI已经影响骨科创伤协会（OTA）成员的方式，同时确定临床应用路径，如2025年OTA年会基础科学焦点论坛上所展示。OTA AI特别工作组的一份报告分享了一些初步成果，包括起草一份立场声明。讨论了AI在骨科创伤中的应用领域，包括预测老年人跌倒风险、基于图像的自动诊断和结局评估能力，以及为依赖虚拟患者队列的计算机模拟临床试验创建框架的努力。这些应用共同表明AI如何正在成为骨科创伤研究中的基础工具。在未来几年，这些产品将从研究实验室走向临床。为使这些工具带来最大益处，必须采用由数据科学家团队与骨科创伤外科医生合作的审慎开发方法。学术界和产业界都在朝这一方向推进——最佳前进路径很可能涉及共同开发努力。随着这些努力推进，OTA成员无疑将参与其中。他们及其患者将成为许多此类进展的主要受益者。

abstract: [Advances in physiology education] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping physiology education, but the central challenge is epistemic, not technological. Learners are often more fluent with AI tools than their instructors, yet less fluent in the physiology those tools describe: a pattern this Perspective terms the reverse native-speaker problem. AI-generated explanations of physiological mechanisms are rarely overtly wrong. An interpretive framework proposed by means of this perspective states that explanations that appear plausible step by step may become become inconsistent when organ systems are considered together. It is therefore argued that the educator role is shifting from transmitting information to certifying coherence and proposes a classroom exercise, the error-hunt, for identifying seeded, systems-level inconsistencies in AI-generated explanations.
zh_abstract: [《Advances in Physiology Education》] 生成式人工智能（AI）正在重塑生理学教育，但核心挑战是认识论层面的，而非技术层面的。学习者往往比其教师更熟练使用AI工具，却对这些人工具所描述的生理学更不熟练：本视角将这一模式称为反向母语者问题。AI生成的生理机制解释很少明显错误。通过本视角提出的一个解释框架指出，逐步看起来合理的解释在将器官系统放在一起考虑时可能变得不一致。因此，本文认为教育者的角色正从传递信息转向认证连贯性，并提出一个课堂练习——找错（error-hunt），用于识别AI生成解释中植入的系统级不一致。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Yang Xiaodong; conditions: Medical Education; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 40; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Laparoscopic skills training requires hand-eye coordination, spatial orientation, instrument control, and precise handling of materials. Structured feedback supports skills development, but frequent individualized instructor feedback may be limited by available time and resources. Generative artificial intelligence (AI) may help organize performance information into personalized training recommendations. This single-center, randomized, parallel-group, active-controlled trial plans to enroll 40 fourth-year clinical medical students with no or limited laparoscopic simulation experience. Participants will be assigned in a 1:1 ratio to AI-assisted personalized feedback or structured rule-based template feedback. Both groups will complete the same training program using a 14-ball pegboard transfer task and study-developed shape-cutting tasks. Training duration, equipment, general instructor guidance, and four scheduled feedback opportunities will be standardized. Fundamentals of Laparoscopic Surgery (FLS) tasks will be used at scheduled assessments rather than as repeated training exercises. The AI group will receive feedback generated through a predefined generative AI workflow using de-identified structured performance records and self-assessments. Outputs will undergo predefined quality review before delivery. The comparison group will receive feedback generated using fixed criteria, priority rules, and feedback statements. The primary outcome is the study-defined Precision Cutting Objective Score on the FLS task after cutting training, approximately 4 weeks after baseline. The key secondary outcome is the study-defined Peg Transfer Objective Score on the FLS task after transfer training, approximately 2 weeks after baseline. Additional assessments will evaluate technical skill development and skill retention 4 to 8 weeks after training completion. Participants will not be informed of their feedback source. Technical performance will be assessed from anonymized videos by evaluators unaware of group assignment. The study tests the hypothesis that AI-assisted personalized feedback improves laparoscopic skills learning more than structured rule-based feedback. Because both groups receive feedback under otherwise standardized training conditions, the comparison is intended to identify the additional educational value of the AI-assisted approach.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Yang Xiaodong；研究条件：医学教育；类型：干预性；分期：不适用；入组人数：40；状态：尚未招募] 腹腔镜技能训练需要手眼协调、空间定向、器械控制和材料精确操作。结构化反馈支持技能发展，但频繁的个体化导师反馈可能受可用时间和资源限制。生成式人工智能（AI）可能有助于将表现信息组织为个性化训练建议。这项单中心、随机、平行组、阳性对照试验计划入组 40 名无或仅有有限腹腔镜模拟经验的四年级临床医学生。参与者将按 1:1 比例分配至 AI 辅助个性化反馈组或结构化基于规则的模板反馈组。两组将完成相同的训练项目，使用 14 球钉板转移任务和研究自行开发的形状切割任务。训练时长、设备、一般导师指导和四次预定反馈机会将标准化。腹腔镜手术基础（Fundamentals of Laparoscopic Surgery, FLS）任务将用于预定评估，而不是作为重复训练练习。AI 组将接受通过预定义的生成式 AI 工作流生成的反馈，该工作流使用去标识化的结构化表现记录和自我评估。输出在交付前将经过预定义的质量审查。对照组将接受使用固定标准、优先级规则和反馈语句生成的反馈。主要结局是切割训练后约基线后 4 周时 FLS 任务上研究定义的精密切割客观评分。关键次要结局是转移训练后约基线后 2 周时 FLS 任务上研究定义的钉转移客观评分。额外评估将评价训练完成后 4 至 8 周的技术技能发展和技能保持。参与者不会被告知其反馈来源。技术表现将由不知道分组情况的评估者根据匿名视频进行评估。该研究检验以下假设：AI 辅助个性化反馈比结构化基于规则的反馈更能改善腹腔镜技能学习。由于两组在其他方面标准化的训练条件下均接受反馈，该比较旨在识别 AI 辅助方法的额外教育价值。
